quote: Можливо, білок як альтернативне джерело енергії утилізується для енергетичного забезпечення процесів детоксикації та екскреції амонію та аміаку
statement: Існує припущення, що білок використовується як джерело енергії для детоксикації та екскреції амонію.
text_en: Існує припущення, що білок використовується як джерело енергії для детоксикації та екскреції амонію.

quote: За 5,0 та 15,0 мг N/дм3 кількість білка вже знижується на 54% у м’язах та 25–27% в зябрах порівняно до контролю

text_en: При концентраціях амонію 5,0 та 15,0 мг N/дм3 кількість білка в м'язах знизилася на 54%, а в зябрах — на 25–27% порівняно з контролем.

quote: Це свідчить, що істотна концентрація амонійного азоту спричиняє очевидне виснаження захисних ресурсів молоді карася
statement: Висока концентрація амонійного азоту призводить до виснаження захисних ресурсів молоді карася.
text_en: Висока концентрація амонійного азоту призводить до виснаження захисних ресурсів молоді карася.

quote: при підвищенні концентрації амонію з 0,1 до 2,5 мг N/дм3 їх рівень зростав прямопропорційно підвищенню концентрації токсиканту та був вищим на 28–31% при максимальній концентрації
statement: При підвищенні концентрації амонію з 0,1 до 2,5 мг N/дм3 рівень загальних ліпідів зростав пропорційно концентрації токсиканту, перевищуючи контроль на 28–31% при максимальній концентрації цього діапазону.
text_en: При підвищенні концентрації амонію з 0,1 до 2,5 мг N/дм3 рівень загальних ліпідів зростав пропорційно концентрації токсиканту, перевищуючи контроль на 28–31% при максимальній концентрації цього діапазону.

quote: Kualitas air merupakan salah satu faktor terpenting yang harus selalu diperhatikan selama pemeliharaan berlangsung.
statement: Kualitas air adalah faktor penting yang harus diperhatikan selama proses pemeliharaan.
text_en: Kualitas air adalah faktor penting yang harus diperhatikan selama proses pemeliharaan.

quote: Adapun parameter kualitas air yang diukur meliputi pH, suhu, dan oksigen terlarut.
statement: Parameter kualitas air yang diukur dalam studi ini mencakup pH, suhu, dan oksigen terlarut.
text_en: Parameter kualitas air yang diukur dalam studi ini mencakup pH, suhu, dan oksigen terlarut.

quote: Berdasarkan Hasil pengukuran dari masing-masing parameter tersebut kisaran rata-rata pH 5,81-6,80, suhu 26,15oC-27,35oC, dan DO 4,85-5,75 ppm.
statement: Rata-rata hasil pengukuran menunjukkan kisaran pH antara 5,81 hingga 6,80, suhu antara 26,15°C hingga 27,35°C, dan oksigen terlarut (DO) antara 4,85 hingga 5,75 ppm.
text_en: Rata-rata hasil pengukuran menunjukkan kisaran pH antara 5,81 hingga 6,80, suhu antara 26,15°C hingga 27,35°C, dan oksigen terlarut (DO) antara 4,85 hingga 5,75 ppm.

statement: Nilai konversi pakan yang kecil menunjukkan efisiensi pemanfaatan pakan yang lebih baik.
text_en: Nilai konversi pakan yang kecil menunjukkan efisiensi pemanfaatan pakan yang lebih baik.

quote: FCR tinggi mengindikasikan pakan tidak tercerna atau pakan kurang disukai oleh ikan.
statement: Nilai FCR yang tinggi mengindikasikan bahwa pakan tidak tercerna dengan baik atau kurang disukai oleh ikan.
text_en: Nilai FCR yang tinggi mengindikasikan bahwa pakan tidak tercerna dengan baik atau kurang disukai oleh ikan.

quote: Menurut Surbakti (2009), jumlah pakan yang terlalu banyak menyebabkan ikan tidak efisien dalam proses pemanfaatannya selain itu energi hasil kecernaan pakan menjadi lebih banyak dikeluarkan apabila pakan yang dikonsumsi lebih banyak sehingga efisiensi pakan rendah.
statement: Jumlah pakan yang berlebihan menyebabkan inefisiensi pemanfaatan pakan karena meningkatnya pengeluaran energi hasil kecernaan.
text_en: Jumlah pakan yang berlebihan menyebabkan inefisiensi pemanfaatan pakan karena meningkatnya pengeluaran energi hasil kecernaan.

quote: Kualitas air yang diamati selama penelitian merupakan kualitas air yang optimal bagi ikan.
statement: Parameter kualitas air yang diamati selama penelitian berada pada kondisi optimal bagi ikan.
text_en: Parameter kualitas air yang diamati selama penelitian berada pada kondisi optimal bagi ikan.

quote: Hal ini sesuai dengan pernyataan Boyd (1990) dalam Nurrahma (2018), suhu optimal untuk ikan Komet yaitu berkisar 26-29ºC.
statement: Suhu optimal untuk pemeliharaan ikan Komet adalah antara 26 hingga 29 derajat Celsius.
text_en: Suhu optimal untuk pemeliharaan ikan Komet adalah antara 26 hingga 29 derajat Celsius.

quote: Perubahan suhu yang secara tiba-tiba dapat menyebabkan ikan stress dan menimbulkan kematian.
statement: Perubahan suhu air yang mendadak dapat memicu stres dan menyebabkan kematian pada ikan.
text_en: Perubahan suhu air yang mendadak dapat memicu stres dan menyebabkan kematian pada ikan.

quote: Suhu yang terlalu rendah akan berpengaruh terhadap aktifitas ikan antara lain menurunnya kemampuan mengambil oksigen (hypoxia), cenderung diam secara bergerombol, menurunnya aktivitas makan dan berenang sehingga akan mengakibatkan berkurangnya imunitas terhadap serangan penyakit (Sihombing, 2018).
statement: Suhu air yang terlalu rendah menurunkan kemampuan pengambilan oksigen, aktivitas makan dan berenang, serta mengurangi imunitas ikan terhadap penyakit.
text_en: Suhu air yang terlalu rendah menurunkan kemampuan pengambilan oksigen, aktivitas makan dan berenang, serta mengurangi imunitas ikan terhadap penyakit.

quote: Oksigen terlarut pada penelitian ini memiliki nilai 4,85-5,75 ppm, ini merupakan yang optimal bagi ikan komet.
statement: Kadar oksigen terlarut sebesar 4,85-5,75 ppm dianggap optimal bagi ikan komet.
text_en: Kadar oksigen terlarut sebesar 4,85-5,75 ppm dianggap optimal bagi ikan komet.

quote: oksigen juga mempengaruhi laju pertumbuhan dan perkembangan ikan.
statement: Ketersediaan oksigen memengaruhi laju pertumbuhan dan perkembangan ikan.
text_en: Ketersediaan oksigen memengaruhi laju pertumbuhan dan perkembangan ikan.

quote: Penggunaan karotenoid harus memperhatikan dosis yang digunakan, karena dosis karotenoid yang terlalu tinggi dapat menyebabkan penurunan daya tahan tubuh dan pewarnaan pada ikan (Novia, 2018).
statement: Dosis karotenoid yang terlalu tinggi dapat menurunkan daya tahan tubuh dan kualitas pewarnaan ikan.
text_en: Dosis karotenoid yang terlalu tinggi dapat menurunkan daya tahan tubuh dan kualitas pewarnaan ikan.
intervention_record: 虾青素或类胡萝卜素过量

quote: Kandungan nutrisi yang sesuai dan baik, tidak hanya memacu pertumbuhan menjadi lebih baik tetapi juga dapat meningkatkan performan warna menjadi cerah.
statement: Nutrisi pakan yang sesuai dan baik memacu pertumbuhan serta meningkatkan kecerahan warna.
text_en: Nutrisi pakan yang sesuai dan baik memacu pertumbuhan serta meningkatkan kecerahan warna.

quote: Akan tetapi penambahan astaxanthin kedalam pakan yang berlebihan dapat menurunkan daya tahan tubuh sehingga berpengaruh terhadap pertumbuhan ikan.
statement: Penambahan astaxanthin yang berlebihan dapat menurunkan daya tahan tubuh dan mempengaruhi pertumbuhan ikan.
text_en: Penambahan astaxanthin yang berlebihan dapat menurunkan daya tahan tubuh dan mempengaruhi pertumbuhan ikan.
intervention_record: 虾青素或类胡萝卜素过量

quote: Bila pakan yang diberikan hanya seadanya maka produksi yang dihasilkan tentu sedikit.
statement: Pakan yang diberikan secara seadanya menghasilkan produksi yang sedikit.
text_en: Pakan yang diberikan secara seadanya menghasilkan produksi yang sedikit.

quote: Kandungan gizi pakan juga harus diperhatikan sehingga hasil ikan yang diperoleh maksimal.
statement: Perhatian terhadap kandungan gizi pakan diperlukan untuk mendapatkan hasil ikan yang maksimal.
text_en: Perhatian terhadap kandungan gizi pakan diperlukan untuk mendapatkan hasil ikan yang maksimal.

quote: Berdasarkan gambar 1, tingkat kelangsungan hidup ikan komet pada perlakuan P2, P3, P4 mencapai angka 100% dan nilai terendah pada perlakuan P1 yaitu 96,67.
statement: Tingkat kelangsungan hidup ikan komet mencapai 100% pada perlakuan P2, P3, dan P4, serta 96,67% pada perlakuan P1.
text_en: Tingkat kelangsungan hidup ikan komet mencapai 100% pada perlakuan P2, P3, dan P4, serta 96,67% pada perlakuan P1.

quote: Pada kadar oksigen terlarut kurang dari 2 mg/l, ikan akan mengalami penurunan nafsu makan dan perkembangannnya kurang baik.
statement: Kadar oksigen terlarut di bawah 2 mg/l menyebabkan penurunan nafsu makan dan perkembangan yang buruk pada ikan.
text_en: Kadar oksigen terlarut di bawah 2 mg/l menyebabkan penurunan nafsu makan dan perkembangan yang buruk pada ikan.
outcome: kualitas air (oksigen terlarut) dan kesehatan/nafsu makan

quote: Kadar oksigen dapat ditingkatkan antara lain dengan cara selalu menyediakan aliran air yang masuk dan membiarkan permukaain air dalam kondisi terbuka (Mahyuddin, 2010).
statement: Menyediakan aliran air masuk dan membiarkan permukaan air terbuka dapat meningkatkan kadar oksigen.
text_en: Menyediakan aliran air masuk dan membiarkan permukaan air terbuka dapat meningkatkan kadar oksigen.

quote: Nilai pH yang optimal untuk ikan Komet berkisar 5.0-6.2, sementara pada penelitian ini nilai pH menunjukkan nilai 5,81-6,80 hal ini masih termasuk kedalam nilai pH yang optimal bagi ikan Komet.
statement: Rentang pH 5,81-6,80 dianggap masih optimal bagi ikan Komet meskipun batas atasnya sedikit melebihi kisaran ideal 5,0-6,2.
text_en: Rentang pH 5,81-6,80 dianggap masih optimal bagi ikan Komet meskipun batas atasnya sedikit melebihi kisaran ideal 5,0-6,2.

quote: Keadaan pH yang dapat mengganggu kehidupan ikan adalah pH yang terlalu rendah (sangat asam) atau sebaliknya terlalu tinggi (sangat basa).
statement: pH yang sangat asam atau sangat basa dapat mengganggu kehidupan ikan.
text_en: pH yang sangat asam atau sangat basa dapat mengganggu kehidupan ikan.

quote: Penambahan astaxanthin pada pakan komersil tidak memberikan pengaruh nyata untuk meningkatkan kecerahan warna, pertumbuhan panjang mutlak, laju pertumbuhan harian, kelangsungan hidup dan berpengaruh nyata terhadap pertumbuhan bobot mutlak.
statement: Penambahan astaxanthin pada pakan tidak mempengaruhi secara nyata kecerahan warna, pertumbuhan panjang, laju pertumbuhan harian, dan kelangsungan hidup, tetapi mempengaruhi secara nyata pertumbuhan bobot mutlak.
text_en: Penambahan astaxanthin pada pakan tidak mempengaruhi secara nyata kecerahan warna, pertumbuhan panjang, laju pertumbuhan harian, dan kelangsungan hidup, tetapi mempengaruhi secara nyata pertumbuhan bobot mutlak.

quote: The fish was subsequently anesthetized and euthanized using MS-222 (STAHERB Co., Ltd., Changsha, China).
statement: 鱼类随后使用MS-222进行麻醉和安乐死。
text_zh: 鱼类随后使用MS-222进行麻醉和安乐死。
text_en: Fish were subsequently anesthetized and euthanized using MS-222.

quote: Tingginya tingkat kelangsungan hidup ikan komet karena disebabkan oleh pemberian pakan yang tepat pada ikan selama penelitian dan kualitas air yang mendukung bagi kelangsungan hidup ikan komet.
statement: Tingginya tingkat kelangsungan hidup ikan komet disebabkan oleh pemberian pakan yang tepat dan kualitas air yang mendukung.
text_en: Tingginya tingkat kelangsungan hidup ikan komet disebabkan oleh pemberian pakan yang tepat dan kualitas air yang mendukung.

quote: Febri (2016a), menyataan bahwa semakin baik metabolisme dalam tubuh ikan maka selera makan ikan meningkat dan daya tahan tubuh akan lingkungan juga semakin baik sehingga tingkat mortalitas kecil pada ikan.
statement: Metabolisme tubuh ikan yang baik meningkatkan selera makan dan daya tahan terhadap lingkungan, sehingga tingkat mortalitas menjadi kecil.
text_en: Metabolisme tubuh ikan yang baik meningkatkan selera makan dan daya tahan terhadap lingkungan, sehingga tingkat mortalitas menjadi kecil.

quote: Kualitas air yang baik akan menyebabkan proses fisiologi dalam tubuh biota berjalan dengan baik, sehingga mendukung pertumbuhan dan tingkat kelangsungan hidup biota (Cahyono, 2009).
statement: Kualitas air yang baik mendukung proses fisiologi, pertumbuhan, dan tingkat kelangsungan hidup biota.
text_en: Kualitas air yang baik mendukung proses fisiologi, pertumbuhan, dan tingkat kelangsungan hidup biota.

quote: Triploid fish have the advantages of infertility, fast growth, strong stress resistance, and good meat quality, which has important economic value
statement: 三倍体鱼类具有不育、生长快、抗应激能力强和肉质好等优势。
text_zh: 三倍体鱼类具有不育、生长快、抗应激能力强和肉质好等优势。
text_en: Triploid fish have advantages such as sterility, fast growth, strong stress resistance, and good meat quality.

quote: All samples were anesthetized with 100 mg/L MS-222 (Sigma-Aldrich, St Louis, MO, USA) before blood collection.
statement: 所有样本在采血前均使用100 mg/L的MS-222进行麻醉。
text_zh: 所有样本在采血前均使用100 mg/L的MS-222进行麻醉。
text_en: All samples were anesthetized with 100 mg/L MS-222 before blood collection.

quote: All materials were obtained during breeding season (April) (2017–2018) and were cultured in open pools (0.067 ha) with suitable pH (7.0–8.5), water temperature (22–24°), dissolved oxygen content (5.0–8.0 mg/L), and adequate forage.
statement: 鱼类在开放池塘中养殖，具有特定的pH值、水温、溶解氧含量和充足的饲料。
text_zh: 鱼类在开放池塘中养殖，具有特定的pH值、水温、溶解氧含量和充足的饲料。
text_en: Fish are farmed in open ponds with specific pH values, water temperatures, dissolved oxygen levels, and adequate feed.

quote: Fish treatments were carried out according to the recommendations in the Guidelines for the Care and Use of Laboratory Animals of the National Advisory Committee for Laboratory Animal Research in China and approved by the Animal Care Committee of Hunan Normal University (Permit number: 4237).
statement: 鱼类处理遵循中国实验动物护理和使用指南的建议，并经过湖南师范大学动物护理委员会批准。
text_zh: 鱼类处理遵循中国实验动物护理和使用指南的建议，并经过湖南师范大学动物护理委员会批准。
text_en: Fish handling followed the recommendations of the Chinese Guide for the Care and Use of Laboratory Animals and was approved by the Animal Care Committee of Hunan Normal University.

quote: Water temperature is a critical environmental factor in aquaculture, and fluctuations in heat on a daily or seasonal basis, as well as changes in culture water temperature, have a significant impact on fish growth
statement: 水温是水产养殖中的关键环境因素，每日或季节性的热量波动以及养殖水温的变化对鱼类生长有显著影响。
text_zh: 水温是水产养殖中的关键环境因素，每日或季节性的热量波动以及养殖水温的变化对鱼类生长有显著影响。
text_en: Water temperature is a key environmental factor in aquaculture; daily or seasonal heat fluctuations and changes in farming water temperature have significant effects on fish growth.

quote: Fish frequently encounter acute heat stress, especially during transport and seasonal changes. These conditions can adversely affect their immune system, antioxidant capacity, muscle mass, and growth performance due to the abrupt changes in their external environment
statement: 鱼类经常遭遇急性热应激，特别是在运输和季节变化期间。由于外部环境的突然变化，这些条件会对它们的免疫系统、抗氧化能力、肌肉量和生长性能产生不利影响。
text_zh: 鱼类经常遭遇急性热应激，特别是在运输和季节变化期间。由于外部环境的突然变化，这些条件会对它们的免疫系统、抗氧化能力、肌肉量和生长性能产生不利影响。
text_en: Fish frequently experience acute heat stress, especially during transport and seasonal changes. Due to sudden changes in the external environment, these conditions adversely affect their immune system, antioxidant capacity, muscle mass, and growth performance.
outcome: 免疫、抗氧化、肌肉量及生长

quote: For instance, high environmental temperatures (36 °C) generally enhance lipid metabolism, diminish fatty acid synthesis, and disrupt the immune system in grass carp
statement: 例如，高环境温度（36°C）通常会增强草鱼的脂质代谢，减少脂肪酸合成，并破坏其免疫系统。
text_zh: 例如，高环境温度（36°C）通常会增强草鱼的脂质代谢，减少脂肪酸合成，并破坏其免疫系统。
text_en: For example, high environmental temperature (36°C) usually enhances lipid metabolism in grass carp, reduces fatty acid synthesis, and disrupts their immune system.
outcome: 脂质代谢、脂肪酸合成及免疫系统

quote: The CON and HS groups were fed a basal diet without tea polyphenols; HSLTP, HSMTP, and HSHTP groups were fed a basal diet with 100, 200, and 400 mg/kg tea polyphenols.
statement: CON和HS组饲喂不含茶多酚的基础日粮，HSLTP、HSMTP和HSHTP组分别饲喂添加100、200和400 mg/kg茶多酚的基础日粮。
text_zh: CON和HS组饲喂不含茶多酚的基础日粮，HSLTP、HSMTP和HSHTP组分别饲喂添加100、200和400 mg/kg茶多酚的基础日粮。
text_en: The CON and HS groups were fed a basal diet without tea polyphenols, while the HSLTP, HSMTP, and HSHTP groups were fed a basal diet supplemented with 100, 200, and 400 mg/kg of tea polyphenols, respectively.
outcome: 饲料营养与添加剂使用

quote: Further, Li et al. found that under heat-stress conditions, TPs could alleviate the stress response of Nile tilapia
statement: Li等人发现，在高温胁迫条件下，茶多酚可以缓解尼罗罗非鱼的应激反应。
text_zh: Li等人发现，在高温胁迫条件下，茶多酚可以缓解尼罗罗非鱼的应激反应。
text_en: Li et al. found that tea polyphenols can alleviate the stress response of Nile tilapia under high-temperature stress conditions.

quote: However, the literature on the effects of TPs in mitigating heat stress in fish is limited, and the mechanisms by which TPs enhance the health status of aquatic animals remain underexplored.
statement: 关于茶多酚（TPs）减轻鱼类热应激效果的文献有限，且茶多酚增强水生动物健康状况的机制尚未得到充分探索。
text_zh: 关于茶多酚（TPs）减轻鱼类热应激效果的文献有限，且茶多酚增强水生动物健康状况的机制尚未得到充分探索。
text_en: There is limited literature on the effect of tea polyphenols (TPs) in alleviating heat stress in fish, and the mechanisms by which tea polyphenols enhance the health status of aquatic animals have not been fully explored.
limitations: 文献有限，机制未充分探索

quote: In the present study, we hypothesize that TP supplementation in feed has the potential to alleviate heat stress in HCC2.
statement: 在本研究中，我们假设饲料中添加茶多酚（TPs）有潜力缓解HCC2的热应激。
text_zh: 在本研究中，我们假设饲料中添加茶多酚（TPs）有潜力缓解HCC2的热应激。
text_en: In this study, we hypothesized that the addition of tea polyphenols (TPs) to feed has the potential to alleviate heat stress in HCC2.

population.species: HCC2 (推测为鲫鱼品系或相关养殖对象，文中未明确全称但后文提及crucian carp)

quote: The water temperature was controlled by electrical heaters, which gradually increased by 1 °C/30 min.
statement: 水温由电加热器控制，并以每30分钟升高1°C的速度逐渐上升。
text_zh: 水温由电加热器控制，并以每30分钟升高1°C的速度逐渐上升。
text_en: The water temperature is controlled by an electric heater and gradually rises at a rate of 1°C every 30 minutes.

quote: Throughout the experiment, adequate dissolved oxygen was maintained, and fish behavior and survival rates (SRs) were monitored and recorded.
statement: 在整个实验过程中，维持了充足的溶解氧，并监测和记录了鱼的行为和存活率。
text_zh: 在整个实验过程中，维持了充足的溶解氧，并监测和记录了鱼的行为和存活率。
text_en: Throughout the entire experiment, sufficient dissolved oxygen was maintained, and fish behavior and survival rates were monitored and recorded.

quote: The fish were anesthetized using MS-222 (Merck, Darmstadt, Germany).
statement: 使用MS-222对鱼进行麻醉。
text_zh: 使用MS-222对鱼进行麻醉。
text_en: Fish were anesthetized using MS-222.

quote: The fish were F2-generation lab-raised HCC2, minimizing wild-caught stress variability.
statement: 使用F2代实验室养殖的HCC2鱼可以最小化野生捕获带来的应激变异性。
text_zh: 使用F2代实验室养殖的HCC2鱼可以最小化野生捕获带来的应激变异性。
text_en: Using F2 generation laboratory-reared HCC2 fish can minimize stress variability caused by wild capture.

quote: The fish were acclimated under natural conditions (26.0 ± 2 °C) with a natural light–dark cycle for one week.
statement: 鱼在自然条件（26.0 ± 2 °C）和自然光暗周期下驯化了一周。
text_zh: 鱼在自然条件（26.0 ± 2 °C）和自然光暗周期下驯化了一周。
text_en: Fish were acclimatized for one week under natural conditions (26.0 ± 2 °C) and a natural light-dark cycle.

quote: Water quality parameters were monitored daily, and no significant changes were observed in dissolved oxygen (6.49–6.82 mg/L), temperature (26.0 ± 2 °C), pH (7.16–7.38), or un-ionized ammonia nitrogen (
statement: 每日监测水质参数，溶解氧、温度、pH值或非离子氨氮未观察到显著变化。
text_zh: 每日监测水质参数，溶解氧、温度、pH值或非离子氨氮未观察到显著变化。
text_en: Daily monitoring of water quality parameters; no significant changes were observed in dissolved oxygen, temperature, pH, or non-ionized ammonia nitrogen.

quote: Dietary supplementation with TPs alleviated ammonia-induced oxidative damage in juvenile Wuchang bream (Megalobrama amblycephala) by enhancing their antioxidant and immune capacities
statement: 日粮中添加茶多酚通过增强抗氧化和免疫能力，减轻了武昌鱼幼鱼的氨诱导氧化损伤。
text_zh: 日粮中添加茶多酚通过增强抗氧化和免疫能力，减轻了武昌鱼幼鱼的氨诱导氧化损伤。
text_en: Dietary supplementation with tea polyphenols (TPs) alleviated ammonia-induced oxidative damage in juvenile Wuchang bream by enhancing antioxidant and immune capabilities.
outcome: 氨胁迫下的氧化损伤与免疫状态

quote: The incorporation of TPs into oxidized fish oil-based feed enhances intestinal morphology, enriches beneficial microbiota, and optimizes hepatic nutrient metabolism in spotted sea bass (Lateolabrax maculatus)
statement: 在氧化鱼油基础饲料中添加茶多酚可改善花鲈的肠道形态、富集有益菌群并优化肝脏营养代谢。
text_zh: 在氧化鱼油基础饲料中添加茶多酚可改善花鲈的肠道形态、富集有益菌群并优化肝脏营养代谢。
text_en: Adding tea polyphenols to an oxidized fish oil basal diet can improve intestinal morphology, enrich beneficial microbiota, and optimize hepatic nutrient metabolism in Lateolabrax maculatus.

quote: Figure 3 Serum (A) and liver (B) antioxidant parameters of hybrid crucian carp fed different levels of tea polyphenols (TPs) under heat-stress exposure.
statement: 图3展示了在热应激暴露下，饲喂不同水平茶多酚的杂交鲫鱼的血清和肝脏抗氧化参数。
text_zh: 图3展示了在热应激暴露下，饲喂不同水平茶多酚的杂交鲫鱼的血清和肝脏抗氧化参数。
text_en: Figure 3 shows the serum and liver antioxidant parameters of hybrid crucian carp fed different levels of tea polyphenols under heat stress exposure.

quote: The control group (CON) and the experimental groups (HSLTP, HSMTP, and HSHTP) changed significantly when compared to the heat stress group (HS) in the mixed (both positive and negative) ion mode.
statement: 与热应激组相比，对照组和实验组（低、中、高剂量茶多酚）在混合离子模式下的代谢谱发生了显著变化。
text_zh: 与热应激组相比，对照组和实验组（低、中、高剂量茶多酚）在混合离子模式下的代谢谱发生了显著变化。
text_en: Compared to the heat stress group, the metabolic profiles of the control group and the experimental groups (low, medium, and high doses of tea polyphenols) changed significantly under mixed ion mode.

quote: Figure 6 Diagrams of the classification of KEGG compounds (A), KEGG pathways (B), and HMDB compounds (C) of hybrid crucian carp livers in response to heat stress.
statement: 图6展示了杂交鲫鱼肝脏在热应激下KEGG化合物、KEGG通路和HMDB化合物的分类。
text_zh: 图6展示了杂交鲫鱼肝脏在热应激下KEGG化合物、KEGG通路和HMDB化合物的分类。
text_en: Figure 6 shows the classification of KEGG compounds, KEGG pathways, and HMDB compounds in the liver of hybrid crucian carp under heat stress.

quote: The growth performance of crucian carp peaks when water temperatures range from 25 to 28 °C.
statement: 鲫鱼的生长性能在水温为25至28°C时达到峰值。
text_zh: 鲫鱼的生长性能在水温为25至28°C时达到峰值。
text_en: The growth performance of crucian carp peaks at water temperatures of 25 to 28°C.

quote: However, as water temperatures increase to between 28 and 31 °C, the relative growth rate markedly decelerates, accompanied by a reduction in lymphocyte counts and an elevation in neutrophil levels [ 7 ].
statement: 当水温升高至28至31°C之间时，鲫鱼的相对生长率显著减慢，并伴有淋巴细胞计数减少和中性粒细胞水平升高。
text_zh: 当水温升高至28至31°C之间时，鲫鱼的相对生长率显著减慢，并伴有淋巴细胞计数减少和中性粒细胞水平升高。
text_en: When the water temperature rises to between 28 and 31°C, the relative growth rate of crucian carp slows significantly, accompanied by a decrease in lymphocyte count and an increase in neutrophil levels.

quote: Unfortunately, the summer water temperatures in the subtropical regions where crucian carp are widely distributed often exceed 28 °C [ 8 ], which poses a significant challenge to crucian carp being able to fully exhibit their inherent growth advantages.
statement: 亚热带地区夏季水温常超过28°C，这对鲫鱼充分发挥其固有生长优势构成了重大挑战。
text_zh: 亚热带地区夏季水温常超过28°C，这对鲫鱼充分发挥其固有生长优势构成了重大挑战。
text_en: In subtropical regions, summer water temperatures often exceed 28°C, which poses a major challenge to crucian carp fully realizing their inherent growth advantages.

quote: Natural and functional additive supplementation has been recommended as a useful method to mitigate fish stress [ 9 ].
statement: 补充天然和功能添加剂已被推荐为缓解鱼类应激的有用方法。
text_zh: 补充天然和功能添加剂已被推荐为缓解鱼类应激的有用方法。
text_en: Supplementation with natural and functional additives has been recommended as a useful method to alleviate fish stress.

quote: The levels of alanine transaminase (ALT), aspartate aminotransferase (AST), glucose, and total bilirubin (T-BIL) in the serum were monitored by the employed assay kits
statement: 血清中的丙氨酸转氨酶（ALT）、天冬氨酸转氨酶（AST）、葡萄糖和总胆红素（T-BIL）水平通过试剂盒进行监测。
text_zh: 血清中的丙氨酸转氨酶（ALT）、天冬氨酸转氨酶（AST）、葡萄糖和总胆红素（T-BIL）水平通过试剂盒进行监测。
text_en: The levels of alanine aminotransferase (ALT), aspartate aminotransferase (AST), glucose, and total bilirubin (T-BIL) in serum were monitored using kits.

quote: The concentrations of cortisol in the serum and heat shock protein-70 (HSP-70) in the liver were detected using a fish-specific enzyme-linked immunosorbent assay (ELISA) kit
statement: 使用鱼类特异性酶联免疫吸附测定（ELISA）试剂盒检测血清中的皮质醇浓度和肝脏中的热休克蛋白-70（HSP-70）。
text_zh: 使用鱼类特异性酶联免疫吸附测定（ELISA）试剂盒检测血清中的皮质醇浓度和肝脏中的热休克蛋白-70（HSP-70）。
text_en: Fish-specific enzyme-linked immunosorbent assay (ELISA) kits were used to detect cortisol concentrations in serum and heat shock protein-70 (HSP-70) in the liver.

quote: The antioxidant-related parameters in the serum and liver tissue, including total superoxide dismutase (SOD), catalase (CAT), glutathione peroxidase (GPx), and malondialdehyde (MDA), were quantified according to the manufacturer’s protocols
statement: 根据制造商方案定量血清和肝组织中的抗氧化相关参数，包括总超氧化物歧化酶（SOD）、过氧化氢酶（CAT）、谷胱甘肽过氧化物酶（GPx）和丙二醛（MDA）。
text_zh: 根据制造商方案定量血清和肝组织中的抗氧化相关参数，包括总超氧化物歧化酶（SOD）、过氧化氢酶（CAT）、谷胱甘肽过氧化物酶（GPx）和丙二醛（MDA）。
text_en: Antioxidant-related parameters in serum and liver tissue were quantified according to the manufacturer's protocol, including total superoxide dismutase (SOD), catalase (CAT), glutathione peroxidase (GPx), and malondialdehyde (MDA).
intervention_record: 抗氧化指标试剂盒检测

quote: Based on the metabolite clustering analysis, dietary TPs protect hybrid crucian carp from acute heat stress mainly by modulating lipid metabolism in the liver.
statement: 基于代谢物聚类分析，日粮中的TPs主要通过调节肝脏脂质代谢来保护杂交鲫鱼免受急性热应激。
text_zh: 基于代谢物聚类分析，日粮中的TPs主要通过调节肝脏脂质代谢来保护杂交鲫鱼免受急性热应激。
text_en: Based on metabolite cluster analysis, dietary TPs protect hybrid crucian carp from acute heat stress mainly by regulating hepatic lipid metabolism.
outcome: 热应激耐受性/肝脏脂质代谢

quote: Compared to the HS group (survival rate at 24 h = 48.3%), the survival rates of the HSLTP, HSMTP, and HSHTP groups were 55.0%, 61.6%, and 68.3%, respectively.
statement: 与热应激组相比，添加低、中、高剂量茶多酚的组在24小时时的存活率分别为55.0%、61.6%和68.3%，均高于热应激组的48.3%。
text_zh: 与热应激组相比，添加低、中、高剂量茶多酚的组在24小时时的存活率分别为55.0%、61.6%和68.3%，均高于热应激组的48.3%。
text_en: Compared with the heat stress group, the survival rates at 24 hours in the groups supplemented with low, medium, and high doses of tea polyphenols were 55.0%, 61.6%, and 68.3%, respectively, all higher than the 48.3% in the heat stress group.

quote: Acute heat stress significantly increased the serum ALT and AST activity of the hybrid crucian carp; however, it did not affect the serum T-BIL concentration.
statement: 急性热应激显著增加了杂交鲫鱼的血清ALT和AST活性，但未影响血清总胆红素浓度。
text_zh: 急性热应激显著增加了杂交鲫鱼的血清ALT和AST活性，但未影响血清总胆红素浓度。
text_en: Acute heat stress significantly increased serum ALT and AST activities in hybrid crucian carp, but did not affect serum total bilirubin concentration.

quote: Dietary TPs significantly decreased the activity of ALT and AST, and the minimum values of ALT and AST appeared in the HSHTP group
statement: 日粮中的茶多酚显著降低了ALT和AST的活性，且HSHTP组（高剂量茶多酚+热应激）的ALT和AST值最低。
text_zh: 日粮中的茶多酚显著降低了ALT和AST的活性，且HSHTP组（高剂量茶多酚+热应激）的ALT和AST值最低。
text_en: Tea polyphenols in the diet significantly reduced ALT and AST activities, and the HSHTP group (high-dose tea polyphenols + heat stress) had the lowest ALT and AST values.

quote: Compared with the CON group, the CAT and GPx enzyme activity of the fish in the HS group were significantly lower
statement: 与对照组相比，热应激组鱼类的CAT和GPx酶活性显著降低。
text_zh: 与对照组相比，热应激组鱼类的CAT和GPx酶活性显著降低。
text_en: Compared to the control group, CAT and GPx enzyme activities in fish in the heat stress group were significantly reduced.

quote: In Figure 5 , the top 10 VIP metabolites were PE(16:0/0:0) (VIP = 1.915), (+/−)4-HDoHE (VIP = 1.770), Tramadol (VIP = 1.764), Shikimic acid 3-phosphate (VIP = 1.705), N-[5-(azepane-1-carbonyl)furan-2-yl]acetamide (VIP = 1.686), Cadaverine (VIP = 1.681), PC(2:0/5-iso PGF2VI) (VIP = 1.665), Glu Leu Ser (VIP = 1.653), Kainic acid (VIP = 1.652), and LysoPS (16:0/0:0) (VIP = 1.637).
statement: 热应激下杂交鲫鱼肝脏中前10位差异代谢物包括PE(16:0/0:0)、(+/-)4-HDoHE、曲马多等。
text_zh: 热应激下杂交鲫鱼肝脏中前10位差异代谢物包括PE(16:0/0:0)、(+/-)4-HDoHE、曲马多等。
text_en: The top 10 differential metabolites in the liver of hybrid crucian carp under heat stress include PE(16:0/0:0), (+/-)4-HDoHE, tramadol, etc.

quote: To further explore the effects of TPs in mitigating heat stress, we applied the KEGG compound database to enrich these DMs for metabolic pathway analysis (Figure 6 B).
statement: 研究应用KEGG数据库分析TPs缓解热应激的代谢途径效应。
text_zh: 研究应用KEGG数据库分析TPs缓解热应激的代谢途径效应。
text_en: The study applied the KEGG database to analyze the metabolic pathway effects of TPs in alleviating heat stress.

quote: This experiment employed heating to simulate extreme environmental temperature changes and further investigate the effect of TP supplementation on the survival rate of hybrid crucian carp (HCC2).
statement: 本实验采用加热模拟极端环境温度变化，以进一步研究茶多酚（TP）补充对杂交鲫鱼存活率的影响。
text_zh: 本实验采用加热模拟极端环境温度变化，以进一步研究茶多酚（TP）补充对杂交鲫鱼存活率的影响。
text_en: This experiment used heating to simulate extreme environmental temperature changes, in order to further study the effect of tea polyphenol (TP) supplementation on the survival rate of hybrid crucian carp.

quote: In contrast, the survival rate in the experimental group without TP supplementation (HS group) was significantly lower.
statement: 相比之下，未添加茶多酚的实验组（HS组）的存活率显著较低。
text_zh: 相比之下，未添加茶多酚的实验组（HS组）的存活率显著较低。
text_en: In contrast, the survival rate of the experimental group without tea polyphenol addition (HS group) was significantly lower.

quote: Our study provides compelling evidence that dietary tea polyphenols (TPs) confer significant protection against acute heat stress in hybrid crucian carp HCC2 through multifaceted mechanisms involving antioxidant enhancement and lipid metabolic regulation.
statement: 本研究表明，日粮茶多酚（TPs）通过涉及抗氧化增强和脂质代谢调节的多方面机制，对杂交鲫鱼HCC2的急性热应激提供显著保护。
text_zh: 本研究表明，日粮茶多酚（TPs）通过涉及抗氧化增强和脂质代谢调节的多方面机制，对杂交鲫鱼HCC2的急性热应激提供显著保护。
text_en: This study indicates that dietary tea polyphenols (TPs) provide significant protection against acute heat stress in hybrid crucian carp HCC2 through multifaceted mechanisms involving enhanced antioxidant capacity and regulation of lipid metabolism.

population.species: 杂交鲫鱼HCC2 (hybrid crucian carp HCC2)

outcome: 热应激耐受性/生理健康

quote: In this study, the supplementation of TPs was shown to enhance fish tolerance to drastic fluctuations in high temperature, in agreement with Duong et al. who found that green tea extract (GTE) enhanced the survival of abalone (Haliotis laevigata Donovan) cultured in high water temperatures [ 27 ].
statement: 在本研究中，补充TPs被证明能增强鱼类对高温剧烈波动的耐受力，这与Duong等人发现绿茶提取物（GTE）提高了在高温水中养殖的鲍鱼存活率的结果一致。
text_zh: 在本研究中，补充TPs被证明能增强鱼类对高温剧烈波动的耐受力，这与Duong等人发现绿茶提取物（GTE）提高了在高温水中养殖的鲍鱼存活率的结果一致。
text_en: In this study, supplementation of TPs was shown to enhance fish tolerance to severe fluctuations in high temperature, which is consistent with the findings by Duong et al. that green tea extract (GTE) improved the survival rate of abalone cultured in high-temperature water.

quote: While survival improved by 20%, combining TPs with cooling protocols or probiotics may enhance their efficacy during prolonged heatwaves.
statement: 虽然存活率提高了20%，但在长时间的热浪期间，将TPs与降温方案或益生菌结合使用可能会提高其功效。
text_zh: 虽然存活率提高了20%，但在长时间的热浪期间，将TPs与降温方案或益生菌结合使用可能会提高其功效。
text_en: Although survival rates increased by 20%, combining TPs with cooling protocols or probiotics may improve their efficacy during prolonged heatwaves.
intervention: TPs combined with cooling or probiotics
intervention_record: 茶多酚结合降温或益生菌

quote: The findings of this study demonstrated that heat stress increased MDA content and decreased CAT and Gpx activities in hybrid crucian carp, suggesting that elevated temperatures induced oxidative stress.
statement: 本研究发现热应激导致杂交鲫鱼MDA含量增加，CAT和Gpx活性降低，表明高温诱导了氧化应激。
text_zh: 本研究发现热应激导致杂交鲫鱼MDA含量增加，CAT和Gpx活性降低，表明高温诱导了氧化应激。
text_en: This study found that heat stress led to an increase in MDA content and a decrease in CAT and Gpx activity in hybrid crucian carp, indicating that high temperature induced oxidative stress.

quote: In our study, pretreatment with TPs mitigated heat-stress-induced ROS generation and MDA accumulation by restoring antioxidant enzyme activities.
statement: 在本研究中，茶多酚（TPs）预处理通过恢复抗氧化酶活性，减轻了热应激诱导的ROS产生和MDA积累。
text_zh: 在本研究中，茶多酚（TPs）预处理通过恢复抗氧化酶活性，减轻了热应激诱导的ROS产生和MDA积累。
text_en: In this study, tea polyphenol (TPs) pretreatment alleviated heat stress-induced ROS production and MDA accumulation by restoring antioxidant enzyme activity.

quote: As renowned antioxidants, TPs can directly engage in redox reactions within fish and positively influence their antioxidant systems [ 41 ].
statement: 作为著名的抗氧化剂，茶多酚可以直接参与鱼体内的氧化还原反应并正面影响其抗氧化系统。
text_zh: 作为著名的抗氧化剂，茶多酚可以直接参与鱼体内的氧化还原反应并正面影响其抗氧化系统。
text_en: As a well-known antioxidant, tea polyphenols can directly participate in redox reactions within fish and positively affect their antioxidant system.

quote: However, the molecular mechanisms by which tea polyphenols influence oxidative stress in fish remain unclear.
statement: 然而，茶多酚影响鱼类氧化应激的分子机制尚不清楚。
text_zh: 然而，茶多酚影响鱼类氧化应激的分子机制尚不清楚。
text_en: However, the molecular mechanism by which tea polyphenols affect oxidative stress in fish is not yet clear.

quote: It plays a vital role in mitigating the effects of heat stress and safeguarding organisms from damage caused by elevated temperatures [ 43 ].
statement: 肝脏在缓解热应激影响及保护生物体免受高温损伤方面发挥重要作用。
text_zh: 肝脏在缓解热应激影响及保护生物体免受高温损伤方面发挥重要作用。
text_en: The liver plays an important role in alleviating the effects of heat stress and protecting organisms from high-temperature damage.

quote: Numerous studies have demonstrated that acute heat stress can significantly alter liver-associated metabolic pathways.
statement: 大量研究表明急性热应激可显著改变肝脏相关的代谢通路。
text_zh: 大量研究表明急性热应激可显著改变肝脏相关的代谢通路。
text_en: Numerous studies have shown that acute heat stress can significantly alter liver-related metabolic pathways.

quote: Bao et al. found that the exposure of tilapia to 35 °C for 48 h resulted in the notable upregulation of miR-1 and miR-122 expression in the liver [ 44 ].
statement: Bao等人发现将罗非鱼暴露于35°C持续48小时导致肝脏中miR-1和miR-122表达显著上调。
text_zh: Bao等人发现将罗非鱼暴露于35°C持续48小时导致肝脏中miR-1和miR-122表达显著上调。
text_en: Bao et al. found that exposing tilapia to 35°C for 48 hours led to a significant upregulation of miR-1 and miR-122 expression in the liver.

quote: Heat stress is a significant environmental challenge that affects cellular homeostasis and metabolic processes in various organisms.
statement: 热应激是影响各种生物体细胞稳态和代谢过程的重要环境挑战。
text_zh: 热应激是影响各种生物体细胞稳态和代谢过程的重要环境挑战。
text_en: Heat stress is an important environmental challenge that affects cellular homeostasis and metabolic processes in various organisms.

quote: Among the critical metabolic pathways influenced by heat stress are glycerophospholipid and arachidonic acid metabolism [ 46 ].
statement: 受热应激影响的关键代谢通路包括甘油磷脂代谢和花生四烯酸代谢。
text_zh: 受热应激影响的关键代谢通路包括甘油磷脂代谢和花生四烯酸代谢。
text_en: Key metabolic pathways affected by heat stress include glycerophospholipid metabolism and arachidonic acid metabolism.

quote: Effects of dietary sodium diformate on growth performance, immunological and biochemical blood indices, antioxidant capacity, and thermal stress tolerance of juvenile common carp (Cprinus carpio)
statement: 日粮中添加甲酸钠对鲤鱼幼鱼的生长性能、免疫和生化血液指标、抗氧化能力以及热应激耐受性有影响。
text_zh: 日粮中添加甲酸钠对鲤鱼幼鱼的生长性能、免疫和生化血液指标、抗氧化能力以及热应激耐受性有影响。
text_en: Dietary supplementation with sodium formate affects the growth performance, immune and biochemical blood parameters, antioxidant capacity, and heat stress tolerance of juvenile common carp.
outcome: 生长性能、免疫状态、抗氧化能力及热应激耐受性

quote: Acute thermal stress reduces skeletal muscle growth and quality in gibel carp (Carassius gibelio)
statement: 急性热应激会降低银鲫的骨骼肌生长和质量。
text_zh: 急性热应激会降低银鲫的骨骼肌生长和质量。
text_en: Acute heat stress reduces the skeletal muscle growth and quality of gibel carp.

quote: Effects of dietary tea polyphenols on growth, immunity and lipid metabolism of
statement: 日粮茶多酚对[未指明物种]的生长、免疫力和脂质代谢有影响。
text_zh: 日粮茶多酚对[未指明物种]的生长、免疫力和脂质代谢有影响。
text_en: Dietary tea polyphenols affect the growth, immunity, and lipid metabolism of [unspecified species].
outcome: 生长、免疫力及脂质代谢

quote: The supplementation of dietary selenium yeast and green tea-derived polyphenols improves antioxidant capacity and immune response in juvenile wuchang bream under ammonia stress.
statement: 日粮补充硒酵母和绿茶多酚可改善氨胁迫下武昌鱼幼鱼的抗氧化能力和免疫反应。
text_zh: 日粮补充硒酵母和绿茶多酚可改善氨胁迫下武昌鱼幼鱼的抗氧化能力和免疫反应。
text_en: Dietary supplementation with selenium yeast and green tea polyphenols can improve the antioxidant capacity and immune response of juvenile Wuchang bream under ammonia stress.
intervention: Selenium yeast and green tea polyphenols
outcome: 抗氧化能力与免疫反应

quote: Effects of oxidized fish oil diet supplemented with tea polyphenols on intestinal health and liver metabolism of spotted sea bass (Lateolabrax maculatus)
statement: 补充茶多酚的氧化鱼油饲料对花鲈肠道健康和肝脏代谢的影响。
text_zh: 补充茶多酚的氧化鱼油饲料对花鲈肠道健康和肝脏代谢的影响。
text_en: The effects of oxidized fish oil diets supplemented with tea polyphenols on gut health and liver metabolism in Lateolabrax maculatus.
intervention: Tea polyphenols in oxidized fish oil diet
intervention_record: 氧化鱼油饲料补充茶多酚

quote: Evaluation of a transgenic tg(hspa8b: Gfp) nile tilapia for monitoring of stress and anti-stress effects of the influence of temperature and vibration.
statement: 评估转基因尼罗罗非鱼用于监测温度和振动影响的应激及抗应激效果。
text_zh: 评估转基因尼罗罗非鱼用于监测温度和振动影响的应激及抗应激效果。
text_en: Evaluate the stress and anti-stress effects of transgenic Nile tilapia used to monitor temperature and vibration impacts.

quote: The impact of rutin on heat stress response of hybrid fish (Carassius auratus cuvieri ♀ x Carassius auratus red var. ♂)
statement: 芦丁对杂交鱼热应激反应的影响。
text_zh: 芦丁对杂交鱼热应激反应的影响。
text_en: The effect of rutin on the heat stress response of hybrid fish.

quote: In this study, we utilized metabolomics to analyze the liver of HCC2 carp and found that heat stress impacted lipid metabolism.
statement: 本研究利用代谢组学分析HCC2鲤鱼的肝脏，发现热应激影响了脂质代谢。
text_zh: 本研究利用代谢组学分析HCC2鲤鱼的肝脏，发现热应激影响了脂质代谢。
text_en: This study used metabolomics to analyze the liver of HCC2 carp and found that heat stress affected lipid metabolism.

quote: Thermal stress typically induces membrane fluidity alterations through lipid peroxidation [ 41 ], but TP supplementation appears to maintain phospholipid composition critical for cellular compartmentalization and signal transduction.
statement: 热应激通常通过脂质过氧化诱导膜流动性改变，但TP补充似乎能维持对细胞区室化和信号转导至关重要的磷脂组成。
text_zh: 热应激通常通过脂质过氧化诱导膜流动性改变，但TP补充似乎能维持对细胞区室化和信号转导至关重要的磷脂组成。
text_en: Heat stress usually induces changes in membrane fluidity through lipid peroxidation, but TP supplementation appears to maintain the phospholipid composition that is crucial for cellular compartmentalization and signal transduction.

quote: While heat stress typically elevates pro-inflammatory prostaglandins [ 28 ], TPs may attenuate inflammatory signaling, potentially via COX2 inhibition, though direct evidence requires future cytokine profiling.
statement: 虽然热应激通常升高促炎前列腺素，但TP可能减轻炎症信号传导，潜在机制是通过COX2抑制，尽管直接证据需要未来的细胞因子谱分析。
text_zh: 虽然热应激通常升高促炎前列腺素，但TP可能减轻炎症信号传导，潜在机制是通过COX2抑制，尽管直接证据需要未来的细胞因子谱分析。
text_en: Although heat stress usually increases pro-inflammatory prostaglandins, TP may reduce inflammatory signaling, with a potential mechanism being COX2 inhibition, although direct evidence requires future cytokine profiling.
limitations: direct evidence requires future cytokine profiling

quote: Suppressed arachidonic acid metabolism (Figure 6 B) aligns with reduced cortisol/glucose, suggesting that TPs attenuate stress-induced eicosanoid signaling.
statement: 受抑制的花生四烯酸代谢与降低的皮质醇/葡萄糖水平一致，表明TP减轻了应激诱导的类二十烷酸信号传导。
text_zh: 受抑制的花生四烯酸代谢与降低的皮质醇/葡萄糖水平一致，表明TP减轻了应激诱导的类二十烷酸信号传导。
text_en: The suppressed arachidonic acid metabolism is consistent with the reduced cortisol/glucose levels, indicating that TP alleviated stress-induced eicosanoid signaling.
outcome: 应激激素与类二十烷酸信号

quote: The present study established dietary tea polyphenols as an effective, eco-friendly intervention against acute heat stress in hybrid crucian carp HCC2.
statement: 本研究确立了日粮添加茶多酚作为对抗杂交鲫鱼HCC2急性热应激的有效且环保的干预措施。
text_zh: 本研究确立了日粮添加茶多酚作为对抗杂交鲫鱼HCC2急性热应激的有效且环保的干预措施。
text_en: This study established dietary supplementation with tea polyphenols as an effective and environmentally friendly intervention against acute heat stress in hybrid crucian carp HCC2.

population.species: 杂交鲫鱼 HCC2 (hybrid crucian carp HCC2)

quote: TP supplementation modulated key metabolic pathways in the liver, particularly those associated with lipid metabolism, which are crucial for coping with heat-induced physiological challenges.
statement: 补充茶多酚调节了肝脏中的关键代谢途径，特别是与脂质代谢相关的途径，这对于应对热诱导的生理挑战至关重要。
text_zh: 补充茶多酚调节了肝脏中的关键代谢途径，特别是与脂质代谢相关的途径，这对于应对热诱导的生理挑战至关重要。
text_en: Tea polyphenol supplementation regulated key metabolic pathways in the liver, particularly those related to lipid metabolism, which is crucial for coping with heat-induced physiological challenges.

quote: These findings provide a scientific basis for implementing TP-supplemented feeding regimes in warm-water aquaculture systems.
statement: 这些发现为在温水养殖系统中实施添加茶多酚的饲喂方案提供了科学依据。
text_zh: 这些发现为在温水养殖系统中实施添加茶多酚的饲喂方案提供了科学依据。
text_en: These findings provide a scientific basis for implementing TP-supplemented feeding regimes in warm-water aquaculture systems.

quote: Our metabolomics approach identifies lipid metabolites as potential biomarkers for heat stress mitigation.
statement: 我们的代谢组学方法将脂质代谢物确定为热应激缓解的潜在生物标志物。
text_zh: 我们的代谢组学方法将脂质代谢物确定为热应激缓解的潜在生物标志物。
text_en: Our metabolomics approach identified lipid metabolites as potential biomarkers for heat stress mitigation.
outcome: 热应激生物标志物识别

quote: Based on dose–response trends and cost–benefit analysis, 200–400 mg/kg TPs are recommended for aquaculture applications.
statement: 基于剂量-反应趋势和成本效益分析，建议在水产养殖应用中使用200-400毫克/千克的茶多酚。
text_zh: 基于剂量-反应趋势和成本效益分析，建议在水产养殖应用中使用200-400毫克/千克的茶多酚。
text_en: Based on dose-response trends and cost-benefit analysis, it is recommended to use 200-400 mg/kg of tea polyphenols in aquaculture applications.

quote: Dietary sodium butyrate ameliorated the blood stress biomarkers, heat shock proteins, and immune response of nile tilapia (Oreochromis niloticus) exposed to heat stress.
statement: 日粮中添加丁酸钠改善了暴露于热应激下的尼罗罗非鱼的血浆应激生物标志物、热休克蛋白和免疫反应。
text_zh: 日粮中添加丁酸钠改善了暴露于热应激下的尼罗罗非鱼的血浆应激生物标志物、热休克蛋白和免疫反应。
text_en: Dietary supplementation with sodium butyrate improved plasma stress biomarkers, heat shock proteins, and immune responses in Nile tilapia exposed to heat stress.
outcome: 热应激生理指标与免疫反应

quote: Heat stress induced hepatocyte apoptosis in largemouth bass Micropterus salmoides via ire1α/traf2/ask1/jnk pathway.
statement: 热应激通过IRE1α/TRAF2/ASK1/JNK途径诱导大口黑鲈肝细胞凋亡。
text_zh: 热应激通过IRE1α/TRAF2/ASK1/JNK途径诱导大口黑鲈肝细胞凋亡。
text_en: Heat stress induces hepatocyte apoptosis in largemouth bass via the IRE1α/TRAF2/ASK1/JNK pathway.

quote: The positive effects of single or conjoint administration of lactic acid bacteria on Channa argus: Digestive enzyme activity, antioxidant capacity, intestinal microbiota and morphology.
statement: 单独或联合施用乳酸菌对乌鳢的消化酶活性、抗氧化能力、肠道菌群和形态有积极影响。
text_zh: 单独或联合施用乳酸菌对乌鳢的消化酶活性、抗氧化能力、肠道菌群和形态有积极影响。
text_en: The administration of lactic acid bacteria, alone or in combination, has positive effects on digestive enzyme activity, antioxidant capacity, gut microbiota, and morphology of Channa argus.
outcome: 消化功能、抗氧化能力及肠道健康

quote: Heat stress (HS) has been shown to adversely affect fish livers and can lead to extensive liver injury [ 28 ].
statement: 热应激（HS）已被证明会对鱼类肝脏产生不利影响，并可能导致广泛的肝损伤。
text_zh: 热应激（HS）已被证明会对鱼类肝脏产生不利影响，并可能导致广泛的肝损伤。
text_en: Heat stress (HS) has been shown to adversely affect fish liver and may cause extensive liver damage.

quote: Khieokhajonkhet et al. found through a ten-week chronic heat stress experiment on goldfish that, as the temperature rose, the levels of ALT and AST in the fish serum showed a linear upward trend, indicating that liver function might have been significantly impaired [ 30 ].
statement: Khieokhajonkhet等人通过为期十周的金鱼慢性热应激实验发现，随着温度升高，鱼血清中的ALT和AST水平呈线性上升趋势，表明肝功能可能受到显著损害。
text_zh: Khieokhajonkhet等人通过为期十周的金鱼慢性热应激实验发现，随着温度升高，鱼血清中的ALT和AST水平呈线性上升趋势，表明肝功能可能受到显著损害。
text_en: Khieokhajonkhet et al. found through a ten-week chronic heat stress experiment on goldfish that as temperature increased, ALT and AST levels in fish serum showed a linear upward trend, indicating that liver function may be significantly impaired.

quote: However, in the present study, TP supplementation demonstrated a hepatoprotective effect, as reflected by the decreased levels of ALT and AST.
statement: 然而，在本研究中，补充TP显示出保肝作用，表现为ALT和AST水平的降低。
text_zh: 然而，在本研究中，补充TP显示出保肝作用，表现为ALT和AST水平的降低。
text_en: However, in this study, TP supplementation showed a hepatoprotective effect, manifested as decreased ALT and AST levels.

quote: Similarly, Lin et al. found that adding dietary TPs to an oxidized fish oil diet enhanced the liver health of spotted seabass (Lateolabrax maculatus) [ 20 ].
statement: 同样，Lin等人发现，在氧化鱼油日粮中添加膳食TP增强了斑点海鲈（Lateolabrax maculatus）的肝脏健康。
text_zh: 同样，Lin等人发现，在氧化鱼油日粮中添加膳食TP增强了斑点海鲈（Lateolabrax maculatus）的肝脏健康。
text_en: Similarly, Lin et al. found that dietary TP supplementation in oxidized fish oil diets enhanced liver health in spotted sea bass (Lateolabrax maculatus).
intervention: Tea polyphenols in oxidized fish oil diet
intervention_record: 氧化鱼油饲料补充茶多酚

quote: In this study, fish fed with TPs showed lower cortisol and glucose levels during heat stress compared to the HS group.
statement: 在本研究中，与HS组相比，喂食TP的鱼在热应激期间表现出较低的皮质醇和葡萄糖水平。
text_zh: 在本研究中，与HS组相比，喂食TP的鱼在热应激期间表现出较低的皮质醇和葡萄糖水平。
text_en: In this study, fish fed TP showed lower cortisol and glucose levels during heat stress compared to the HS group.
outcome: 应激生理指标 (皮质醇, 葡萄糖)

quote: These results suggested TPs have an anti-stress effect by inhibiting cortisol elevation.
statement: 这些结果表明TP通过抑制皮质醇升高具有抗应激作用。
text_zh: 这些结果表明TP通过抑制皮质醇升高具有抗应激作用。
text_en: These results indicate that TP has an anti-stress effect by inhibiting the increase in cortisol.

quote: Therefore, FM replacement is challenging, and some of the plant protein sources previously investigated inhibit the growth and the antioxidant and immune capacity of this fish species.
statement: 因此，鱼粉替代具有挑战性，且此前研究的一些植物蛋白源会抑制该鱼种的生长、抗氧化能力和免疫能力。
text_zh: 因此，鱼粉替代具有挑战性，且此前研究的一些植物蛋白源会抑制该鱼种的生长、抗氧化能力和免疫能力。
text_en: Therefore, fishmeal replacement is challenging, and some plant protein sources from previous studies inhibit the growth, antioxidant capacity, and immune capacity of this fish species.

quote: FM reduction with and without AE supplementation did not significantly affect the survival rate (SR) (p > 0.05).
statement: 鱼粉减量无论是否添加AE均对存活率无显著影响。
text_zh: 鱼粉减量无论是否添加AE均对存活率无显著影响。
text_en: Reduced fishmeal, with or without AE addition, had no significant effect on survival rate.
intervention_record: 鱼粉减量并补充藻类提取物

quote: FM reduction with and without AE supplementation did not significantly influence the plasma’s contents: alanine aminotransferase (ALT), total cholesterol (TC), albumin (ALB), alkaline phosphatase (ALP), total protein (TP), aspartate aminotransferase (AST), glucose (GLU), and triglycerides (TG) (p > 0.05).
statement: 鱼粉减量且无论是否添加AE，均未显著影响血浆中的丙氨酸氨基转移酶、总胆固醇、白蛋白、碱性磷酸酶、总蛋白、天冬氨酸氨基转移酶、葡萄糖和甘油三酯含量。
text_zh: 鱼粉减量且无论是否添加AE，均未显著影响血浆中的丙氨酸氨基转移酶、总胆固醇、白蛋白、碱性磷酸酶、总蛋白、天冬氨酸氨基转移酶、葡萄糖和甘油三酯含量。
text_en: Fish meal reduction, with or without AE addition, did not significantly affect the plasma contents of alanine aminotransferase, total cholesterol, albumin, alkaline phosphatase, total protein, aspartate aminotransferase, glucose and triglycerides.
intervention: Fishmeal reduction with or without AE

quote: Gibel carp were acclimatized to the culturing environment, and commercial feed (Tongwei Group, Wuxi, China) was administered for 15 d.
statement: 鲫鱼被驯化以适应养殖环境，并投喂商业饲料15天。
text_zh: 鲫鱼被驯化以适应养殖环境，并投喂商业饲料15天。
text_en: Crucian carp were acclimated to the farming environment and fed commercial feed for 15 days.

quote: Additionally, phospholipid remodeling enzymes, such as lysophosphatidylcholine acyltransferase (LPCAT), could be upregulated by TPs to enhance membrane integrity under heat stress [ 49 ].
statement: 在热应激条件下，茶多酚可能上调磷脂重塑酶（如溶血磷脂酰胆碱酰基转移酶）以增强膜完整性。
text_zh: 在热应激条件下，茶多酚可能上调磷脂重塑酶（如溶血磷脂酰胆碱酰基转移酶）以增强膜完整性。
text_en: Under heat stress conditions, tea polyphenols may upregulate phospholipid remodeling enzymes (such as lysophosphatidylcholine acyltransferase) to enhance membrane integrity.

quote: Yan et al. found that largemouth bass exposed to 33 °C for 8 weeks had a poorer growth performance, more severe liver damage, and altered lipid levels [ 50 ].
statement: Yan等人发现，大口黑鲈在33°C暴露8周后生长性能较差，肝脏损伤更严重，且脂质水平发生改变。
text_zh: Yan等人发现，大口黑鲈在33°C暴露8周后生长性能较差，肝脏损伤更严重，且脂质水平发生改变。
text_en: Yan et al. found that largemouth bass exposed to 33°C for 8 weeks had poorer growth performance, more severe liver damage, and altered lipid levels.
outcome: 生长性能、肝脏健康、脂质代谢

quote: The expression of genes related to gluconeogenesis and lipid metabolism was downregulated, while glycolysis-related genes were upregulated at 33 °C.
statement: 在33°C时，与糖异生和脂质代谢相关的基因表达下调，而与糖酵解相关的基因表达上调。
text_zh: 在33°C时，与糖异生和脂质代谢相关的基因表达下调，而与糖酵解相关的基因表达上调。
text_en: At 33°C, gene expression related to gluconeogenesis and lipid metabolism was downregulated, while gene expression related to glycolysis was upregulated.

quote: This suggests that enhanced glycolysis and inhibited gluconeogenesis and lipid metabolism may improve the capacity to cope with heat stress.
statement: 这表明增强的糖酵解以及受抑制的糖异生和脂质代谢可能会提高应对热应激的能力。
text_zh: 这表明增强的糖酵解以及受抑制的糖异生和脂质代谢可能会提高应对热应激的能力。
text_en: This suggests that enhanced glycolysis and inhibited gluconeogenesis and lipid metabolism may improve the ability to cope with heat stress.

quote: The 24 h acute stress model mimics short-term heatwaves, which are increasingly frequent due to climate change.
statement: 24小时急性应激模型模拟了因气候变化而日益频繁的短期热浪。
text_zh: 24小时急性应激模型模拟了因气候变化而日益频繁的短期热浪。
text_en: The 24-hour acute stress model simulated short-term heatwaves that are becoming more frequent due to climate change.

quote: Chronic heat stress (weeks to months) may induce distinct adaptations, such as the sustained upregulation of heat shock proteins or shifts in energy metabolism, warranting further investigation.
statement: 慢性热应激（数周至数月）可能诱导不同的适应机制，如热休克蛋白的持续上调或能量代谢的转变，这需要进一步研究。
text_zh: 慢性热应激（数周至数月）可能诱导不同的适应机制，如热休克蛋白的持续上调或能量代谢的转变，这需要进一步研究。
text_en: Chronic heat stress (weeks to months) may induce different adaptation mechanisms, such as sustained upregulation of heat shock proteins or a shift in energy metabolism, which requires further research.

quote: The relative expression of HSP70 serves as a potential stress marker in aquatic animals, providing protection and thermotolerance during heat stress [ 33 ].
statement: HSP70的相对表达量可作为水生动物潜在的应激标志物，在热应激期间提供保护和耐热性。
text_zh: HSP70的相对表达量可作为水生动物潜在的应激标志物，在热应激期间提供保护和耐热性。
text_en: The relative expression level of HSP70 can serve as a potential stress marker in aquatic animals, providing protection and heat tolerance during heat stress.

quote: Our study found that hybrid crucian carp fed TPs had reduced HSP70 levels in serum, suggesting a mitigated effect of heat stress.
statement: 本研究发现饲喂茶多酚的杂交鲫鱼血清中HSP70水平降低，表明热应激效应得到缓解。
text_zh: 本研究发现饲喂茶多酚的杂交鲫鱼血清中HSP70水平降低，表明热应激效应得到缓解。
text_en: This study found that serum HSP70 levels were reduced in hybrid crucian carp fed tea polyphenols, indicating that the heat stress effect was alleviated.

quote: Lower HSP70 levels in the TP groups indicates reduced proteotoxic stress, not impaired chaperone function, as survival and antioxidant markers improved.
statement: 茶多酚组较低的HSP70水平表明蛋白质毒性应激减少，而非伴侣蛋白功能受损，因为存活率和抗氧化指标有所改善。
text_zh: 茶多酚组较低的HSP70水平表明蛋白质毒性应激减少，而非伴侣蛋白功能受损，因为存活率和抗氧化指标有所改善。
text_en: The lower HSP70 levels in the tea polyphenols group indicate reduced proteotoxic stress rather than impaired chaperone function, as survival rates and antioxidant indicators improved.
outcome: 蛋白质毒性应激与存活率

quote: External factors like temperature and salinity can cause abnormal metabolism, leading to excessive ROS production [ 35 ].
statement: 温度和盐度等外部因素会导致代谢异常，从而产生过量的活性氧（ROS）。
text_zh: 温度和盐度等外部因素会导致代谢异常，从而产生过量的活性氧（ROS）。
text_en: External factors such as temperature and salinity can lead to metabolic abnormalities, resulting in the production of excess reactive oxygen species (ROS).

quote: Global warming poses significant challenges to aquaculture, as elevated water temperatures adversely affect fish health and survival.
statement: 全球变暖对水产养殖构成重大挑战，因为升高的水温会对鱼类的健康和生存产生不利影响。
text_zh: 全球变暖对水产养殖构成重大挑战，因为升高的水温会对鱼类的健康和生存产生不利影响。
text_en: Global warming poses a major challenge to aquaculture because elevated water temperatures adversely affect the health and survival of fish.
outcome: 高温胁迫下的健康与存活率

quote: This study investigated the effects and potential mechanisms of dietary tea polyphenols (TPs) on acute heat stress and survival in hybrid crucian carp HCC2.
statement: 本研究调查了日粮茶多酚（TPs）对杂交鲫鱼HCC2急性热应激和存活率的影响及潜在机制。
text_zh: 本研究调查了日粮茶多酚（TPs）对杂交鲫鱼HCC2急性热应激和存活率的影响及潜在机制。
text_en: This study investigated the effects and potential mechanisms of dietary tea polyphenols (TPs) on acute heat stress and survival rate in hybrid crucian carp HCC2.

quote: The fish in the control (CON) group and heat stress group (HS group, three replicates, each containing 20 fish, n = 60 per group) were fed diets with 0 mg/kg TPs, and the three experimental groups (HSLTP, HSMTP, and HSHTP, n = 20 × 3 replicates) were fed the diets with 100, 200, or 400 mg/kg TPs for 60 days.
statement: 对照组和热应激组的鱼喂食含0 mg/kg TPs的饲料，三个实验组喂食含100、200或400 mg/kg TPs的饲料持续60天。
text_zh: 对照组和热应激组的鱼喂食含0 mg/kg TPs的饲料，三个实验组喂食含100、200或400 mg/kg TPs的饲料持续60天。
text_en: Fish in the control group and heat stress group were fed diets containing 0 mg/kg TPs, while fish in the three experimental groups were fed diets containing 100, 200 or 400 mg/kg TPs for 60 days.

quote: Further, fish in the experimental groups (HS, HSLTP, HSMTP, and HSHTP) were exposed at 38 °C for 24 h to induce acute heat stress.
statement: 此外，实验组中的鱼在38°C下暴露24小时以诱导急性热应激。
text_zh: 此外，实验组中的鱼在38°C下暴露24小时以诱导急性热应激。
text_en: In addition, the fish in the experimental group were exposed to 38°C for 24 hours to induce acute heat stress.

quote: Notably, dietary TPs significantly improved survival rates and antioxidant enzyme levels and reduced serum ALT, AST, cortisol, glucose, MDA, and liver HSP-70 levels in the heat-stressed fish.
statement: 值得注意的是，日粮TPs显著提高了热应激鱼的存活率和抗氧化酶水平，并降低了血清ALT、AST、皮质醇、葡萄糖、MDA和肝脏HSP-70水平。
text_zh: 值得注意的是，日粮TPs显著提高了热应激鱼的存活率和抗氧化酶水平，并降低了血清ALT、AST、皮质醇、葡萄糖、MDA和肝脏HSP-70水平。
text_en: It is worth noting that dietary TPs significantly improved the survival rate and antioxidant enzyme levels of heat-stressed fish, and reduced serum ALT, AST, cortisol, glucose, MDA, and liver HSP-70 levels.
outcome: 存活率、抗氧化状态、肝损伤指标、应激激素、脂质过氧化及热休克蛋白表达

quote: Metabolomic analysis revealed that TPs modulated lipid metabolism, particularly glycerophospholipid and arachidonic acid pathways, which may contribute to a higher tolerance to acute heat stress.
statement: 代谢组学分析显示，TPs调节了脂质代谢，特别是甘油磷脂和花生四烯酸途径，这可能有助于提高对急性热应激的耐受性。
text_zh: 代谢组学分析显示，TPs调节了脂质代谢，特别是甘油磷脂和花生四烯酸途径，这可能有助于提高对急性热应激的耐受性。
text_en: Metabolomic analysis showed that TPs regulated lipid metabolism, particularly the glycerophospholipid and arachidonic acid pathways, which may contribute to improved tolerance to acute heat stress.

quote: These findings suggest that TPs are a promising, eco-friendly feed additive for protecting fish from heat stress and optimizing aquaculture practices.
statement: 这些发现表明，TPs是一种有前景的环保型饲料添加剂，可用于保护鱼类免受热应激并优化水产养殖实践。
text_zh: 这些发现表明，TPs是一种有前景的环保型饲料添加剂，可用于保护鱼类免受热应激并优化水产养殖实践。
text_en: These findings indicate that TPs are a promising eco-friendly feed additive that can be used to protect fish from heat stress and optimize aquaculture practices.
outcome: 热应激防护与养殖优化

quote: fish may not make good use of some plant protein sources due to anti-nutritional factors [ 8 ].
statement: 由于抗营养因子的存在，鱼类可能无法有效利用某些植物蛋白源。
text_zh: 由于抗营养因子的存在，鱼类可能无法有效利用某些植物蛋白源。
text_en: Due to the presence of antinutritional factors, fish may not be able to effectively utilize certain plant protein sources.

quote: Some plant proteins considered for use as FM substitutes must be evaluated in terms of their nutrient content and possible harmful effects on fish health [ 9 ].
statement: 作为鱼粉替代品的某些植物蛋白必须就其营养成分和对鱼类健康的潜在有害影响进行评估。
text_zh: 作为鱼粉替代品的某些植物蛋白必须就其营养成分和对鱼类健康的潜在有害影响进行评估。
text_en: Some plant proteins used as fish meal substitutes must be evaluated for their nutritional composition and potential harmful effects on fish health.

quote: The foregoing substances may inhibit the growth and antioxidant and immune capacity of aquatic animals [ 13 ].
statement: 前述物质（如凝集素、蛋白酶抑制剂、游离棉酚、硫代葡萄糖苷代谢物）可能会抑制水生动物的生长以及抗氧化和免疫能力。
text_zh: 前述物质（如凝集素、蛋白酶抑制剂、游离棉酚、硫代葡萄糖苷代谢物）可能会抑制水生动物的生长以及抗氧化和免疫能力。
text_en: The aforementioned substances (such as lectins, protease inhibitors, free gossypol, and glucosinolate metabolites) may inhibit the growth, antioxidant capacity, and immune function of aquatic animals.
outcome: 生长性能; 抗氧化能力; 免疫功能

quote: Supplementation with certain functional substances also mitigated the harmful effects of plant protein sources [ 16 , 17 ].
statement: 补充某些功能性物质也能减轻植物蛋白源的有害影响。
text_zh: 补充某些功能性物质也能减轻植物蛋白源的有害影响。
text_en: Supplementing certain functional substances can also mitigate the harmful effects of plant protein sources.

quote: The present work showed that AE supplementation improved both the antioxidant and the immune capacity, thereby alleviating the adverse effects of FM reduction, such as growth inhibition, low antioxidant capacity, and immunosuppression in Gibel carp.
statement: 本研究表明，AE补充改善了抗氧化和免疫能力，从而减轻了鱼粉减少带来的生长抑制、低抗氧化能力和免疫抑制等不利影响。
text_zh: 本研究表明，AE补充改善了抗氧化和免疫能力，从而减轻了鱼粉减少带来的生长抑制、低抗氧化能力和免疫抑制等不利影响。
text_en: This study showed that AE supplementation improved antioxidant and immune capacity, thereby alleviating the adverse effects of fishmeal reduction, such as growth inhibition, low antioxidant capacity, and immunosuppression.
outcome: 抗氧化能力与免疫功能

quote: on significantly decreased the activity levels of manganese superoxide dismutase (Mn-SOD), catalase (CAT), total antioxidant capacity (T-AOC), glutathione peroxidase (GPx), total superoxide dismutase (T-SOD), and copper/zinc superoxide dismutase (Cu/Zn-SOD) and improved the malondialdehyde (MDA) content
statement: 某处理显著降低了锰超氧化物歧化酶、过氧化氢酶、总抗氧化能力、谷胱甘肽过氧化物酶、总超氧化物歧化酶和铜/锌超氧化物歧化酶的活性水平，并改善了丙二醛含量。
text_zh: 某处理显著降低了锰超氧化物歧化酶、过氧化氢酶、总抗氧化能力、谷胱甘肽过氧化物酶、总超氧化物歧化酶和铜/锌超氧化物歧化酶的活性水平，并改善了丙二醛含量。
text_en: A certain treatment significantly reduced the activity levels of manganese superoxide dismutase, catalase, total antioxidant capacity, glutathione peroxidase, total superoxide dismutase, and copper/zinc superoxide dismutase, and improved malondialdehyde content.

quote: Significantly higher mRNA levels of interferon gamma (IFN-γ) were observed in the 5% FM group than in the 10% FM group
statement: 与10%鱼粉组相比，5%鱼粉组的干扰素γ（IFN-γ）mRNA水平显著更高。
text_zh: 与10%鱼粉组相比，5%鱼粉组的干扰素γ（IFN-γ）mRNA水平显著更高。
text_en: Compared to the 10% fishmeal group, the interferon gamma (IFN-γ) mRNA levels in the 5% fishmeal group were significantly higher.

quote: The mRNA level of IFN-γ was significantly lower in the 10% FM with AE supplementation group than in the 5% FM group
statement: 与5%鱼粉组相比，添加AE的10%鱼粉组的IFN-γ mRNA水平显著更低。
text_zh: 与5%鱼粉组相比，添加AE的10%鱼粉组的IFN-γ mRNA水平显著更低。
text_en: Compared with the 5% fish meal group, IFN-γ mRNA levels were significantly lower in the 10% fish meal group supplemented with AE.
intervention_record: 鱼粉减量并补充藻类提取物

quote: promotes overall health, antioxidant capacity, digestive enzyme production, and functions in fish and shrimp
statement: 藻类提取物促进鱼虾的整体健康、抗氧化能力、消化酶产生及功能。
text_zh: 藻类提取物促进鱼虾的整体健康、抗氧化能力、消化酶产生及功能。
text_en: Algae extract promotes the overall health, antioxidant capacity, digestive enzyme production and function of fish and shrimp.

quote: elicited positive changes in the gastrointestinal microflora
statement: 藻类提取物引起胃肠道菌群的积极变化。
text_zh: 藻类提取物引起胃肠道菌群的积极变化。
text_en: Algae extract caused positive changes in the gastrointestinal microbiota.

quote: Ulva lactuca has been found to be useful as a feed additive to combat heat stress in greenlip abalone (Haliotis laevigata Donovan)
statement: 石莼（Ulva lactuca）被发现可用作饲料添加剂以对抗绿唇鲍鱼的热应激。
text_zh: 石莼（Ulva lactuca）被发现可用作饲料添加剂以对抗绿唇鲍鱼的热应激。
text_en: Ulva lactuca was found to be usable as a feed additive to counteract heat stress in green-lipped abalone.

quote: red algae (Gracilaria arcuata) in Nile tilapia (Oreochromis niloticus)
statement: 红藻（弓江蓠）被用于尼罗罗非鱼的饲料中。
text_zh: 红藻（弓江蓠）被用于尼罗罗非鱼的饲料中。
text_en: Red algae (Gracilaria arcuata) was used in the feed for Nile tilapia.

quote: Algae meal and its extract are rich in bioactive substances... which are beneficial to the growth, development, and immune regulation of aquatic animals.
statement: 藻粉及其提取物富含生物活性物质，有利于水生动物的生长、发育和免疫调节。
text_zh: 藻粉及其提取物富含生物活性物质，有利于水生动物的生长、发育和免疫调节。
text_en: Algae powder and its extracts are rich in bioactive substances, which are beneficial for the growth, development, and immune regulation of aquatic animals.

quote: There were no significant interactions among the foregoing parameters and FM reduction with and without AE supplementation (p > 0.05).
statement: 鱼粉减量与藻类提取物（AE）补充之间在血浆生化指标上无显著交互作用。
text_zh: 鱼粉减量与藻类提取物（AE）补充之间在血浆生化指标上无显著交互作用。
text_en: There was no significant interaction between fish meal reduction and algae extract (AE) supplementation on plasma biochemical indicators.
intervention_record: 鱼粉减量并补充藻类提取物

quote: After the acclimatization period, healthy fish that were similar in size were selected and randomly assigned in triplicate to 1 of 24 tanks (450 L/tank), with 20 fish/tank.
statement: 适应期后，选择大小相似的健康鱼随机分配到24个水箱中，每箱20条鱼。
text_zh: 适应期后，选择大小相似的健康鱼随机分配到24个水箱中，每箱20条鱼。
text_en: After the acclimation period, healthy fish of similar size were randomly assigned to 24 tanks, with 20 fish per tank.
intervention: Healthy fish screening and random assignment
intervention_record: 健康鱼筛选与随机分配

quote: The fish were manually fed 2 mm long pellets at 07:30, 11:30, and 16:30 daily for 56 d (8 wks).
statement: 鱼每天在07:30、11:30和16:30被人工投喂2毫米长的颗粒饲料，持续56天。
text_zh: 鱼每天在07:30、11:30和16:30被人工投喂2毫米长的颗粒饲料，持续56天。
text_en: Fish were manually fed 2 mm long pellet feed at 07:30, 11:30 and 16:30 daily for 56 days.

quote: The fish were fed at 3% of their body weight with respect to the amount of feed.
statement: 鱼的投喂量为体重的3%。
text_zh: 鱼的投喂量为体重的3%。
text_en: The feeding amount for fish is 3% of body weight.

quote: An ambient natural photoperiod was used, and the levels of water temperature, pH, and dissolved oxygen were within the ranges of 24–26 °C, 7.3–7.8, and 5.6–6.5 mg/L, respectively.
statement: 使用自然光周期，水温、pH值和溶解氧水平分别保持在24-26°C、7.3-7.8和5.6-6.5 mg/L范围内。
text_zh: 使用自然光周期，水温、pH值和溶解氧水平分别保持在24-26°C、7.3-7.8和5.6-6.5 mg/L范围内。
text_en: Using a natural photoperiod, water temperature, pH, and dissolved oxygen levels were maintained within the ranges of 24-26°C, 7.3-7.8, and 5.6-6.5 mg/L, respectively.

quote: Before experimental sampling, fish were fasted for 24 h, and then the fish from each tank was enumerated and weighed.
statement: 实验取样前，鱼禁食24小时，然后对每个水箱中的鱼进行计数和称重。
text_zh: 实验取样前，鱼禁食24小时，然后对每个水箱中的鱼进行计数和称重。
text_en: Before experimental sampling, fish were fasted for 24 hours, and then the fish in each tank were counted and weighed.

quote: Of these, three were used for whole-fish composition analysis, and three were subjected to blood drawing and dissection under tricaine methanesulphonate (MS-222) anesthesia.
statement: 其中三条用于全鱼成分分析，另外三条在三甲磺酸（MS-222）麻醉下进行采血和解剖。
text_zh: 其中三条用于全鱼成分分析，另外三条在三甲磺酸（MS-222）麻醉下进行采血和解剖。
text_en: Three of them were used for whole-fish composition analysis, and the other three underwent blood sampling and dissection under MS-222 (tricaine methanesulfonate) anesthesia.
intervention: Blood sampling and dissection under MS-222

quote: Proteins from plants contain antinutritional factors [ 34 ], which lowered the growth of fish.
statement: 植物蛋白含有抗营养因子，这会降低鱼类的生长。
text_zh: 植物蛋白含有抗营养因子，这会降低鱼类的生长。
text_en: Plant proteins contain anti-nutritional factors, which reduce fish growth.

quote: The results demonstrated that no crucian carp deaths occurred during the 14-day observation period, and they remained in normal condition.
statement: 在14天的观察期内，鲫鱼没有死亡，且保持正常状态。
text_zh: 在14天的观察期内，鲫鱼没有死亡，且保持正常状态。
text_en: During the 14-day observation period, crucian carp did not die and remained in normal condition.

quote: Effect of water-soluble polysaccharide extract from the green alga Ulva rigida on growth performance, antioxidant enzyme activity, and immune stimulation of grey mullet Mugil cephalus.
statement: 绿藻Ulva rigida的水溶性多糖提取物对灰梭鱼（Mugil cephalus）的生长性能、抗氧化酶活性和免疫刺激有影响。
text_zh: 绿藻Ulva rigida的水溶性多糖提取物对灰梭鱼（Mugil cephalus）的生长性能、抗氧化酶活性和免疫刺激有影响。
text_en: Water-soluble polysaccharide extracts from the green alga Ulva rigida affect growth performance, antioxidant enzyme activity, and immune stimulation in grey mullet (Mugil cephalus).
intervention_record: 石莼水溶性多糖提取物
outcome: 生长性能、抗氧化酶活性、免疫刺激

quote: Grape seed extract and dried macroalgae, Ulva lactuca Linnaeus, improve survival of greenlip abalone, Haliotis laevigata Donovan, at high water temperature.
statement: 葡萄籽提取物和干大型藻类（石莼 Ulva lactuca）提高了高温下绿唇鲍鱼（Haliotis laevigata）的存活率。
text_zh: 葡萄籽提取物和干大型藻类（石莼 Ulva lactuca）提高了高温下绿唇鲍鱼（Haliotis laevigata）的存活率。
text_en: Grape seed extract and dried macroalgae (Ulva lactuca) improved the survival rate of greenlip abalone (Haliotis laevigata) under high temperatures.
intervention: Grape seed extract and dried Ulva
intervention_record: 葡萄籽提取物和干石莼

quote: There were no significant changes in ALB, ALP, ALT, AST, TP, GLU, GLU, and TC in plasma.
statement: 血浆中的白蛋白、碱性磷酸酶、谷丙转氨酶、谷草转氨酶、总蛋白、葡萄糖和总胆固醇没有显著变化。
text_zh: 血浆中的白蛋白、碱性磷酸酶、谷丙转氨酶、谷草转氨酶、总蛋白、葡萄糖和总胆固醇没有显著变化。
text_en: There were no significant changes in plasma albumin, alkaline phosphatase, alanine aminotransferase, aspartate aminotransferase, total protein, glucose, and total cholesterol.
outcome: 血液生化指标/肝脏健康

quote: FM reduction with AE supplementation mitigated the decrease in antioxidant capacity by heightening the activity of antioxidant enzymes and related gene expressions
statement: 在减少鱼粉的情况下，添加藻类提取物通过提高抗氧化酶活性和相关基因表达，缓解了抗氧化能力的下降。
text_zh: 在减少鱼粉的情况下，添加藻类提取物通过提高抗氧化酶活性和相关基因表达，缓解了抗氧化能力的下降。
text_en: Under reduced fish meal conditions, adding algae extract alleviated the decline in antioxidant capacity by increasing antioxidant enzyme activity and related gene expression.
intervention_record: 鱼粉减量并补充藻类提取物

quote: which mitigated the decrease in immune capacity by affecting the expression of inflammatory factors
statement: 通过影响炎症因子的表达，缓解了免疫能力的下降。
text_zh: 通过影响炎症因子的表达，缓解了免疫能力的下降。
text_en: Alleviated the decline in immune capacity by affecting the expression of inflammatory factors.
intervention_record: 鱼粉减量并补充藻类提取物

quote: In summary, AE supplementation could alleviate the negative effects of FM reduction in Gibel carp.
statement: 总之，添加藻类提取物可以缓解鲫鱼中鱼粉减少带来的负面影响。
text_zh: 总之，添加藻类提取物可以缓解鲫鱼中鱼粉减少带来的负面影响。
text_en: In summary, adding algae extract can mitigate the negative effects of reduced fishmeal in crucian carp.

quote: Influence of Ulva meal on growth, feed utilization, and body composition of juvenile Nile tilapia (Oreochromis niloticus) at two levels of dietary lipid.
statement: Ulva meal influences the growth, feed utilization, and body composition of juvenile Nile tilapia at two levels of dietary lipid.
text_en: Ulva meal influences the growth, feed utilization, and body composition of juvenile Nile tilapia at two levels of dietary lipid.
outcome: growth, feed utilization, and body composition

quote: Effect of two seaweeds (Ulva lactuca and Enteromorpha Linza) as a feed additive in diets on growth performance, feed utilization and body composition of Rainbow trout (Oncorhynchus mykiss)
statement: Two seaweeds (Ulva lactuca and Enteromorpha Linza) as feed additives affect the growth performance, feed utilization, and body composition of Rainbow trout.
text_en: Two seaweeds (Ulva lactuca and Enteromorpha Linza) as feed additives affect the growth performance, feed utilization, and body composition of Rainbow trout.
outcome: growth performance, feed utilization, and body composition

quote: Dietary chlorella (Chlorella vulgaris) supplementation effectively improves body color, alleviates muscle inflammation and inhibits apoptosis in largemouth bass (Micropterus salmoides)
statement: Dietary chlorella supplementation improves body color, alleviates muscle inflammation, and inhibits apoptosis in largemouth bass.
text_en: Dietary chlorella supplementation improves body color, alleviates muscle inflammation, and inhibits apoptosis in largemouth bass.
outcome: body color, muscle inflammation, and apoptosis

quote: Jian carp (Cyprinus carpio var. Jian) intestinal immune responses, antioxidant status and tight junction protein mRNA expression are modulated via Nrf2 and PKC in response to dietary arginine deficiency.
statement: Dietary arginine deficiency modulates intestinal immune responses, antioxidant status, and tight junction protein mRNA expression in Jian carp via Nrf2 and PKC.
text_en: Dietary arginine deficiency modulates intestinal immune responses, antioxidant status, and tight junction protein mRNA expression in Jian carp via Nrf2 and PKC.
outcome: intestinal immune responses, antioxidant status, and tight junction protein mRNA expression

quote: Enhanced muscle nutrient content and flesh quality, resulting from tryptophan, is associated with anti-oxidative damage referred to the Nrf2 and TOR signalling factors in young grass carp (Ctenopharyngodon idella): Avoid tryptophan deficiency or
statement: Tryptophan enhances muscle nutrient content and flesh quality in young grass carp, which is associated with anti-oxidative damage involving Nrf2 and TOR signalling factors; tryptophan deficiency should be avoided.
text_en: Tryptophan enhances muscle nutrient content and flesh quality in young grass carp, which is associated with anti-oxidative damage involving Nrf2 and TOR signalling factors; tryptophan deficiency should be avoided.
outcome: muscle nutrient content, flesh quality, and oxidative damage

quote: However, fishmeal is one of the best protein sources, and problems such as growth inhibition and immune regulation disorders often occur after fishmeal substitution, which restricts a further reduction in the use of fishmeal.
statement: 鱼粉是优质蛋白源，鱼粉替代后常出现生长抑制和免疫调节紊乱等问题，限制了鱼粉的进一步减少使用。
text_zh: 鱼粉是优质蛋白源，鱼粉替代后常出现生长抑制和免疫调节紊乱等问题，限制了鱼粉的进一步减少使用。
text_en: Fish meal is a high-quality protein source. After fish meal replacement, problems such as growth inhibition and immune regulation disorders often occur, limiting further reduction in the use of fish meal.

quote: This study investigated the role of algal extract in fishmeal substitution and found that supplementation of algal extract when fishmeal reduction was effective in alleviating problems such as growth inhibition and reduced immunity.
statement: 研究发现，在减少鱼粉时补充藻类提取物能有效缓解生长抑制和免疫力下降等问题。
text_zh: 研究发现，在减少鱼粉时补充藻类提取物能有效缓解生长抑制和免疫力下降等问题。
text_en: Research found that supplementing with algae extract when reducing fishmeal can effectively alleviate problems such as growth inhibition and decreased immunity.

quote: Hence, AE supplementation might increase antioxidant enzymes to lower the body’s stress level.
statement: 藻类提取物（AE）补充可能通过增加抗氧化酶来降低鱼体的应激水平。
text_zh: 藻类提取物（AE）补充可能通过增加抗氧化酶来降低鱼体的应激水平。
text_en: Algae extract (AE) supplementation may reduce stress levels in fish by increasing antioxidant enzymes.
outcome: 氧化应激与抗氧化能力

quote: A possible explanation is that algae meal and its extract are rich in bioactive substances, such as sulphated polysaccharides [ 56 , 57 ], that regulate the antioxidant capacity and immunity in fish and shrimp [ 21 , 22 , 26 ].
statement: 一种可能的解释是，藻粉及其提取物富含硫酸化多糖等生物活性物质，这些物质可调节鱼虾的抗氧化能力和免疫力。
text_zh: 一种可能的解释是，藻粉及其提取物富含硫酸化多糖等生物活性物质，这些物质可调节鱼虾的抗氧化能力和免疫力。
text_en: One possible explanation is that algae powder and its extracts are rich in bioactive substances such as sulfated polysaccharides, which can regulate the antioxidant capacity and immunity of fish and shrimp.

quote: Here, FM reduction without AE supplementation downregulated Mn-SOD and GPx, whereas FM reduction with AE supplementation counteracted these negative effects [ 59 , 60 , 61 ].
statement: 在本研究中，未添加AE的鱼粉减量组下调了Mn-SOD和GPx，而添加AE的鱼粉减量组抵消了这些负面影响。
text_zh: 在本研究中，未添加AE的鱼粉减量组下调了Mn-SOD和GPx，而添加AE的鱼粉减量组抵消了这些负面影响。
text_en: In this study, the reduced fish meal group without AE supplementation downregulated Mn-SOD and GPx, while the reduced fish meal group with AE supplementation offset these negative effects.
intervention_record: 鱼粉减量并补充藻类提取物

quote: Thus, AE supplementation reversed the negative effects of FM reduction by improving antioxidant enzyme activity and, by extension, the antioxidant capacity.
statement: 因此，AE补充通过改善抗氧化酶活性进而提高抗氧化能力，逆转了鱼粉减量的负面影响。
text_zh: 因此，AE补充通过改善抗氧化酶活性进而提高抗氧化能力，逆转了鱼粉减量的负面影响。
text_en: Therefore, algae extract (AE) supplementation improved antioxidant enzyme activity and thereby enhanced antioxidant capacity, reversing the negative effects of fish meal reduction.

quote: Here, FM reduction without AE supplementation upregulated TNF-α.
statement: 在本研究中，未添加AE的鱼粉减量组上调了TNF-α。
text_zh: 在本研究中，未添加AE的鱼粉减量组上调了TNF-α。
text_en: In this study, the fish meal reduction group without AE supplementation upregulated TNF-α.

quote: Proinflammatory cytokines were upregulated in fish administered a low-FM diet [ 64 , 65 , 66 ].
statement: 在喂食低鱼粉日粮的鱼中，促炎细胞因子被上调。
text_zh: 在喂食低鱼粉日粮的鱼中，促炎细胞因子被上调。
text_en: Pro-inflammatory cytokines were upregulated in fish fed a low-fish-meal diet.

quote: In the present work, however, FM reduction with AE supplementation downregulated TNF-α.
statement: 然而在本工作中，添加AE的鱼粉减量组下调了TNF-α。
text_zh: 然而在本工作中，添加AE的鱼粉减量组下调了TNF-α。
text_en: However, in this study, the fish meal reduction group supplemented with AE downregulated TNF-α.
intervention_record: 鱼粉减量并补充藻类提取物

quote: Hence, AE supplementation alleviated the post-FM reduction inflammatory response.
statement: 因此，AE补充缓解了鱼粉减量后的炎症反应。
text_zh: 因此，AE补充缓解了鱼粉减量后的炎症反应。
text_en: Therefore, AE supplementation alleviated the inflammatory response after fish meal reduction.

quote: In contrast, FM reduction with AE supplementation downregulated INF-γ possibly by attenuating the inflammatory response, triggering negative feedback and downregulating anti-inflammatory factors.
statement: 相比之下，添加AE的鱼粉减量组下调了INF-γ，这可能是通过减弱炎症反应、触发负反馈并下调抗炎因子实现的。
text_zh: 相比之下，添加AE的鱼粉减量组下调了INF-γ，这可能是通过减弱炎症反应、触发负反馈并下调抗炎因子实现的。
text_en: In contrast, the fish meal reduction group supplemented with AE downregulated INF-γ, which may be achieved by attenuating the inflammatory response, triggering negative feedback, and downregulating anti-inflammatory factors.
intervention_record: 鱼粉减量并补充藻类提取物

quote: Vaccines are widely regarded as one of the most effective means of preventing bacterial diseases in fish, owing to their high specificity, minimal side effects, and long-lasting immune protection (5).
statement: 疫苗因具有高特异性、副作用小和免疫保护持久等特点，被广泛认为是预防鱼类细菌性疾病的最有效手段之一。
text_zh: 疫苗因具有高特异性、副作用小和免疫保护持久等特点，被广泛认为是预防鱼类细菌性疾病的最有效手段之一。
text_en: Vaccines are widely considered one of the most effective means for preventing bacterial diseases in fish due to their high specificity, minor side effects, and long-lasting immune protection.

quote: Although research on vaccines against A. veronii (including inactivated vaccines, live attenuated vaccines, and subunit vaccines) has made progress, commercial vaccines remain in the development or clinical trial stages, and their safety and immunogenic efficacy require further comprehensive evaluation (6 – 8).
statement: 尽管针对维氏气单胞菌的疫苗研究已取得进展，但商业疫苗仍处于开发或临床试验阶段，其安全性和免疫原性效力需要进一步全面评估。
text_zh: 尽管针对维氏气单胞菌的疫苗研究已取得进展，但商业疫苗仍处于开发或临床试验阶段，其安全性和免疫原性效力需要进一步全面评估。
text_en: Although progress has been made in vaccine research against Aeromonas veronii, commercial vaccines are still in the development or clinical trial stage, and their safety and immunogenic efficacy require further comprehensive evaluation.
limitations: 商业疫苗处于开发或临床试验阶段

quote: OMVs exhibited favorable safety profiles in crucian carp and significantly enhanced serum bactericidal activity.
statement: 外膜囊泡（OMVs）在鲫鱼中表现出良好的安全性，并显著增强了血清杀菌活性。
text_zh: 外膜囊泡（OMVs）在鲫鱼中表现出良好的安全性，并显著增强了血清杀菌活性。
text_en: Outer membrane vesicles (OMVs) showed good safety in crucian carp and significantly enhanced serum bactericidal activity.

quote: Furthermore, OMVs displayed potent immunogenicity, effectively elevating the levels of key serum immune enzymes, immune factors, and IgM, thereby significantly boosting both the innate and adaptive immune responses in crucian carp.
statement: OMVs显示出强免疫原性，有效提高了关键血清免疫酶、免疫因子和IgM的水平，从而显著增强了鲫鱼的先天性和适应性免疫反应。
text_zh: OMVs显示出强免疫原性，有效提高了关键血清免疫酶、免疫因子和IgM的水平，从而显著增强了鲫鱼的先天性和适应性免疫反应。
text_en: OMVs showed strong immunogenicity, effectively increasing the levels of key serum immune enzymes, immune factors and IgM, thereby significantly enhancing the innate and adaptive immune responses in crucian carp.

quote: Critically, OMVs effectively enhanced the immunoprotective efficacy conferred by inactivated A. veronii whole cells, significantly improving the resistance of crucian carp to A. veronii infection.
statement: OMVs有效增强了灭活维氏气单胞菌全细胞提供的免疫保护效力，显著提高了鲫鱼对维氏气单胞菌感染的抵抗力。
text_zh: OMVs有效增强了灭活维氏气单胞菌全细胞提供的免疫保护效力，显著提高了鲫鱼对维氏气单胞菌感染的抵抗力。
text_en: OMVs effectively enhanced the immunoprotective efficacy provided by inactivated Aeromonas veronii whole cells, significantly improving the resistance of crucian carp to Aeromonas veronii infection.

quote: To date, the prevention and control of A. veronii -associated diseases have primarily relied on antibiotics. However, the widespread use of antibiotics has led to increasingly prominent issues, including enhanced antibiotic resistance, compromised host immunity, drug residues, and environmental pollution (3 , 4).
statement: 目前，维氏气单胞菌相关疾病的预防和控制主要依赖抗生素，但抗生素的广泛使用导致了耐药性增强、宿主免疫力受损、药物残留和环境污染等日益突出的问题。
text_zh: 目前，维氏气单胞菌相关疾病的预防和控制主要依赖抗生素，但抗生素的广泛使用导致了耐药性增强、宿主免疫力受损、药物残留和环境污染等日益突出的问题。
text_en: Currently, the prevention and control of Aeromonas veronii-related diseases mainly rely on antibiotics, but the widespread use of antibiotics has led to increasingly prominent problems such as enhanced drug resistance, impaired host immunity, drug residues, and environmental pollution.
outcome: 宿主免疫力与环境健康
counterevidence: 导致耐药性增强、宿主免疫力受损、药物残留和环境污染

quote: Aeromonas veronii (A. veronii) causes hemorrhagic septicemia and enteritis in aquatic animals, posing a threat to global aquaculture.
statement: 维氏气单胞菌引起水生动物的出血性败血症和肠炎，对全球水产养殖构成威胁。
text_zh: 维氏气单胞菌引起水生动物的出血性败血症和肠炎，对全球水产养殖构成威胁。
text_en: Aeromonas veronii causes hemorrhagic septicemia and enteritis in aquatic animals, posing a threat to global aquaculture.

quote: Conventional vaccines are inadequate due to short immune duration, narrow antigenic spectrum, and insufficient commercialization.
statement: 传统疫苗因免疫持续时间短、抗原谱窄以及商业化不足而效果不佳。
text_zh: 传统疫苗因免疫持续时间短、抗原谱窄以及商业化不足而效果不佳。
text_en: Conventional vaccines are ineffective due to short duration of immunity, narrow antigen spectrum, and insufficient commercialization.
limitations: short immune duration, narrow antigenic spectrum, and insufficient commercialization

quote: Here, no significant changes in plasma ALB, ALP, ALT, AST, TP, GLU, TG, or TC levels were found during FM reduction with and without AE supplementation, demonstrating that FM reduction with AE supplementation had limited effects on any of the foregoing blood biochemical indices.
statement: 在此研究中，无论是否添加AE，鱼粉减量期间血浆ALB、ALP、ALT、AST、TP、GLU、TG或TC水平均未发现显著变化，表明添加AE的鱼粉减量对上述血液生化指标影响有限。
text_zh: 在此研究中，无论是否添加AE，鱼粉减量期间血浆ALB、ALP、ALT、AST、TP、GLU、TG或TC水平均未发现显著变化，表明添加AE的鱼粉减量对上述血液生化指标影响有限。
text_en: In this study, no significant changes were found in plasma ALB, ALP, ALT, AST, TP, GLU, TG or TC levels during the fish meal reduction period, regardless of whether AE was added, indicating that fish meal reduction with added AE had limited effects on the above blood biochemical indicators.
intervention: Fishmeal reduction with or without AE
outcome: 血液生化指标/健康状态

quote: Here, FM reduction without AE supplementation lowered the activity levels of T-AOC, GPx, T-SOD, and Mn-SOD.
statement: 在此研究中，不添加AE的鱼粉减量降低了T-AOC、GPx、T-SOD和Mn-SOD的活性水平。
