text_zh: 在此研究中，不添加AE的鱼粉减量降低了T-AOC、GPx、T-SOD和Mn-SOD的活性水平。
text_en: In this study, fish meal reduction without AE addition decreased the activity levels of T-AOC, GPx, T-SOD and Mn-SOD.

quote: A low-FM diet reduced antioxidant enzyme activities in olive flounder [ 26 ].
statement: 低鱼粉日粮降低了牙鲆的抗氧化酶活性。
text_zh: 低鱼粉日粮降低了牙鲆的抗氧化酶活性。
text_en: Low fish meal diets reduced the antioxidant enzyme activity of olive flounder.

quote: Here, FM reduction without AE supplementation improved intestinal MDA levels.
statement: 在此研究中，不添加AE的鱼粉减量改善了肠道MDA水平。
text_zh: 在此研究中，不添加AE的鱼粉减量改善了肠道MDA水平。
text_en: In this study, fish meal reduction without AE supplementation improved intestinal MDA levels.

quote: Earlier studies reported that FM reduction increased the MDA levels in juvenile grass carp (Ctenopharyngodon idella) [ 46 ], allogynogenetic Crucian Carp [ 47 ], and juvenile starry flounder (Platichthys stellatus) [ 48 ].
statement: 早期研究报道，鱼粉减量增加了草鱼幼鱼、异育银鲫和星斑川鲽幼鱼的MDA水平。
text_zh: 早期研究报道，鱼粉减量增加了草鱼幼鱼、异育银鲫和星斑川鲽幼鱼的MDA水平。
text_en: Early studies reported that fishmeal reduction increased MDA levels in grass carp juveniles, allogynogenetic gibel carp, and spotted halibut juveniles.

population.species: 草鱼幼鱼、异育银鲫、星斑川鲽幼鱼

quote: Bactericidal activity of crucian carp serum a Group Bactericidal rate of different serum dilution multiples (%） Bactericidal titer 1:1 1:2 1:3 1:4 1:5 1:6 PBS 21.94 ± 2.49 a ... OMVs 71.88 ± 4.53 b ... AV 79.63 ± 2.36 b ... OMVs + AV 78.75 ± 5.55 b
statement: 血清杀菌活性数据显示，OMVs、AV及OMVs+AV组的杀菌率显著高于PBS对照组。
text_zh: 血清杀菌活性数据显示，OMVs、AV及OMVs+AV组的杀菌率显著高于PBS对照组。
text_en: Serum bactericidal activity data showed that the bactericidal rates of the OMVs, AV, and OMVs+AV groups were significantly higher than those of the PBS control group.

quote: At day 14, the OMV + Av group reached a titer of 1:320, which was significantly higher than that of the other three groups (P P Table 1 . Overall, all three experimental groups enhanced serum antibody levels in crucian carp, with the most pronounced elevation observed in the OMV + Av group.
statement: 在第14天，OMV + Av组的抗体滴度达到1:320，显著高于其他三组；总体而言，三个实验组均提高了鲫鱼的血清抗体水平，其中OMV + Av组的提升最为明显。
text_zh: 在第14天，OMV + Av组的抗体滴度达到1:320，显著高于其他三组；总体而言，三个实验组均提高了鲫鱼的血清抗体水平，其中OMV + Av组的提升最为明显。
text_en: On day 14, the antibody titer in the OMV + Av group reached 1:320, significantly higher than that of the other three groups; overall, all three experimental groups increased serum antibody levels in crucian carp, with the OMV + Av group showing the most pronounced increase.

quote: Therefore, AE supplementation might have inhibited oxidative damage by upregulating the antioxidant enzymes that degrade ROS, such as superoxide ions and hydroxyl radicals [ 51 ].
statement: 因此，补充AE可能通过上调降解ROS（如超氧离子和羟基自由基）的抗氧化酶来抑制氧化损伤。
text_zh: 因此，补充AE可能通过上调降解ROS（如超氧离子和羟基自由基）的抗氧化酶来抑制氧化损伤。
text_en: Therefore, supplementing with AE may inhibit oxidative damage by upregulating antioxidant enzymes that degrade ROS (such as superoxide ions and hydroxyl radicals).

quote: Similarly to our study, Solieria chordalis and Ulva lactuca supplementation could also improve antioxidant enzyme activity [ 26 ], which supported our results.
statement: 与本研究类似，补充Solieria chordalis和Ulva lactuca也能提高抗氧化酶活性，这支持了我们的结果。
text_zh: 与本研究类似，补充Solieria chordalis和Ulva lactuca也能提高抗氧化酶活性，这支持了我们的结果。
text_en: Similar to this study, supplementation with Solieria chordalis and Ulva lactuca also increased antioxidant enzyme activity, which supports our results.

quote: Here, AE supplementation might increase antioxidant enzyme activity, prevent oxidative damage, and protect against ROS in Gibel carp [ 52 , 53 ].
statement: 在此，补充AE可能会增加异育银鲫的抗氧化酶活性，防止氧化损伤并抵御ROS。
text_zh: 在此，补充AE可能会增加异育银鲫的抗氧化酶活性，防止氧化损伤并抵御ROS。
text_en: Here, dietary AE supplementation may increase the antioxidant enzyme activity of gibel carp, prevent oxidative damage and defend against ROS.
outcome: 抗氧化能力/氧化损伤防护

quote: Spirulina supplementation in feed could also heighten intestinal antioxidant enzyme activity to prevent oxidative damage by inhibiting ROS formation [ 54 ].
statement: 饲料中添加螺旋藻也可以通过抑制ROS形成来提高肠道抗氧化酶活性以防止氧化损伤。
text_zh: 饲料中添加螺旋藻也可以通过抑制ROS形成来提高肠道抗氧化酶活性以防止氧化损伤。
text_en: Adding spirulina to feed can also improve intestinal antioxidant enzyme activity by inhibiting ROS formation to prevent oxidative damage.
outcome: 肠道抗氧化酶活性/氧化损伤

quote: Furthermore, Gracilaria spp. supplementation in feed could also enhance antioxidant capacity in European seabass (Dicentrarchus labrax) [ 55 ].
statement: 此外，饲料中添加Gracilaria spp.也能增强欧洲海鲈的抗氧化能力。
text_zh: 此外，饲料中添加Gracilaria spp.也能增强欧洲海鲈的抗氧化能力。
text_en: In addition, adding Gracilaria spp. to the feed can also enhance the antioxidant capacity of European sea bass.

quote: In addition to this, intestinal MDA levels were lower in the fish administered with FM reduction with AE supplementation than in those administered FM reduction without AE supplementation in the present study, which also supported the above results.
statement: 除此之外，本研究中饲喂添加AE的鱼粉减量组的肠道MDA水平低于未添加AE的鱼粉减量组，这也支持了上述结果。
text_zh: 除此之外，本研究中饲喂添加AE的鱼粉减量组的肠道MDA水平低于未添加AE的鱼粉减量组，这也支持了上述结果。
text_en: In addition, in this study, the intestinal MDA levels of the fishmeal-reduced group fed with AE supplementation were lower than those of the fishmeal-reduced group without AE supplementation, which also supports the above results.

quote: Histopathological analysis using hematoxylin and eosin (H&E) staining revealed no significant pathological changes in the liver, spleen, kidney, midgut, and gill of crucian carp in both the experimental and PBS group (phosphate-buffered saline, PBS) (Fig. 3B through F).
statement: 使用苏木精和伊红（H&E）染色的组织病理学分析显示，实验组和PBS对照组的鲫鱼的肝、脾、肾、中肠和鳃均无显著病理变化。
text_zh: 使用苏木精和伊红（H&E）染色的组织病理学分析显示，实验组和PBS对照组的鲫鱼的肝、脾、肾、中肠和鳃均无显著病理变化。
text_en: Histopathological analysis using hematoxylin and eosin (H&E) staining showed no significant pathological changes in the liver, spleen, kidney, mid-intestine, and gills of crucian carp in both the experimental group and the PBS control group.

quote: Challenge test analysis in Fig. 6 revealed a large quantity of mortality in the PBS group within 48 h post-challenge, culminating in 100% lethality within 7 days.
statement: 攻毒试验分析显示，PBS组在攻毒后48小时内出现大量死亡，并在7天内达到100%的致死率。
text_zh: 攻毒试验分析显示，PBS组在攻毒后48小时内出现大量死亡，并在7天内达到100%的致死率。
text_en: Challenge test analysis showed that the PBS group experienced massive deaths within 48 hours post-challenge and reached a 100% mortality rate within 7 days.

quote: Infected crucian carp displayed characteristic pathological manifestations, including hemorrhagic lesions and tissue ulceration.
statement: 受感染的鲫鱼表现出特征性的病理表现，包括出血性病变和组织溃疡。
text_zh: 受感染的鲫鱼表现出特征性的病理表现，包括出血性病变和组织溃疡。
text_en: Infected crucian carp exhibit characteristic pathological manifestations, including hemorrhagic lesions and tissue ulcers.

quote: After 14 days of post-challenge monitoring, the OMV + Av group demonstrated a significantly higher relative percent survival than the OMV group (P
statement: 在攻毒后监测14天后，OMV + Av组的相对存活率显著高于OMV组。
text_zh: 在攻毒后监测14天后，OMV + Av组的相对存活率显著高于OMV组。
text_en: After monitoring for 14 days post-challenge, the relative survival rate of the OMV + Av group was significantly higher than that of the OMV group.

quote: OMV + Av treatment yields highest survival rate, significantly outperforming other treatments and PBS control.
statement: OMV + Av处理产生了最高的存活率，显著优于其他处理和PBS对照。
text_zh: OMV + Av处理产生了最高的存活率，显著优于其他处理和PBS对照。
text_en: OMV + Av treatment produced the highest survival rate, significantly better than other treatments and the PBS control.

quote: A possible explanation is that algae meal and its extract are enriched in bioactive substances such as sulphated polysaccharides, vitamins, minerals, and peptides [ 24 ], which is beneficial to the digestibility and intestinal morphology of fish [ 26 ].
statement: 一种可能的解释是，藻粉及其提取物富含硫酸化多糖、维生素、矿物质和肽等生物活性物质，这有利于鱼类的消化性和肠道形态。
text_zh: 一种可能的解释是，藻粉及其提取物富含硫酸化多糖、维生素、矿物质和肽等生物活性物质，这有利于鱼类的消化性和肠道形态。
text_en: A possible explanation is that algae powder and its extracts are rich in bioactive substances such as sulfated polysaccharides, vitamins, minerals, and peptides, which benefit the digestibility and intestinal morphology of fish.

quote: Furthermore, Solieria chordalis and Ulva lactuca supplementation could also improve digestive enzyme activity, such as amylase and lipase [ 26 ].
statement: 此外，石花菜和石莼的补充还可以改善淀粉酶和脂肪酶等消化酶的活性。
text_zh: 此外，石花菜和石莼的补充还可以改善淀粉酶和脂肪酶等消化酶的活性。
text_en: In addition, supplementation with Gelidium and Ulva can also improve the activity of digestive enzymes such as amylase and lipase.

quote: Similar studies have been found in white-spotted snappers fed with Ulva lactuca [ 29 ].
statement: 在喂食石莼的白斑笛鲷中也发现了类似的研究结果。
text_zh: 在喂食石莼的白斑笛鲷中也发现了类似的研究结果。
text_en: Similar research results were also found in Lethrinus nebulosus fed with Ulva.

quote: Hence, AE supplementation could also improve metabolic capability by increasing digestive enzyme activity.
statement: 因此，AE补充也可以通过增加消化酶活性来提高代谢能力。
text_zh: 因此，AE补充也可以通过增加消化酶活性来提高代谢能力。
text_en: Therefore, AE supplementation can also improve metabolic capacity by increasing digestive enzyme activity.

quote: Immunogenicity evaluation demonstrated that OMVs administered alone or in combination with inactivated A. veronii vaccine significantly improved the serum antibody titers and bactericidal activity in crucian carp.
statement: 免疫原性评估表明，单独施用或与灭活维氏气单胞菌疫苗联合施用的外膜囊泡显著提高了鲫鱼的血清抗体滴度和杀菌活性。
text_zh: 免疫原性评估表明，单独施用或与灭活维氏气单胞菌疫苗联合施用的外膜囊泡显著提高了鲫鱼的血清抗体滴度和杀菌活性。
text_en: Immunogenicity assessment showed that outer membrane vesicles administered alone or in combination with an inactivated Aeromonas veronii vaccine significantly increased serum antibody titers and bactericidal activity in crucian carp.

quote: OMVs alone or combined with inactivated A. veronii vaccine significantly increased the levels of ACP, AKP, LZM, CAT, LDH, and SOD.
statement: 单独使用或与灭活维氏气单胞菌疫苗联合使用的外膜囊泡显著增加了ACP、AKP、LZM、CAT、LDH和SOD的水平。
text_zh: 单独使用或与灭活维氏气单胞菌疫苗联合使用的外膜囊泡显著增加了ACP、AKP、LZM、CAT、LDH和SOD的水平。
text_en: Outer membrane vesicles, used alone or in combination with an inactivated Aeromonas veronii vaccine, significantly increased the levels of ACP, AKP, LZM, CAT, LDH and SOD.

quote: Notably, the increases in ACP and LDH levels were more pronounced in the OMVs + Av group, suggesting a synergistic effect of OMVs and inactivated A. veronii vaccine that enhances defense against microbial infections and antioxidant stress capacity in crucian carp.
statement: OMVs+Av组中ACP和LDH水平的增加更为显著，表明OMVs与灭活A. veronii疫苗具有协同效应，增强了鲫鱼对微生物感染的防御能力和抗氧化应激能力。
text_zh: OMVs+Av组中ACP和LDH水平的增加更为显著，表明OMVs与灭活A. veronii疫苗具有协同效应，增强了鲫鱼对微生物感染的防御能力和抗氧化应激能力。
text_en: The increase in ACP and LDH levels was more significant in the OMVs+Av group, indicating a synergistic effect between OMVs and the inactivated A. veronii vaccine, which enhanced the defense against microbial infection and antioxidant stress capacity of crucian carp.

quote: The relative expression levels of all four immune-related genes were upregulated to varying degrees across the tissues.
statement: 四种免疫相关基因（TGF-β, TNF-α, IL-10, IL-1β）在各组织中的相对表达水平均有不同程度的上调。
text_zh: 四种免疫相关基因（TGF-β, TNF-α, IL-10, IL-1β）在各组织中的相对表达水平均有不同程度的上调。
text_en: The relative expression levels of four immune-related genes (TGF-β, TNF-α, IL-10, IL-1β) were upregulated to varying degrees in all tissues.

quote: TNF-α , IL-10 , and IL-1β genes were higher in both the Av group and the OMV + Av group compared to the OMV group and the PBS group
statement: 与OMV组和PBS组相比，Av组和OMV + Av组的TNF-α、IL-10和IL-1β基因表达水平更高。
text_zh: 与OMV组和PBS组相比，Av组和OMV + Av组的TNF-α、IL-10和IL-1β基因表达水平更高。
text_en: Compared with the OMV group and the PBS group, the TNF-α, IL-10, and IL-1β gene expression levels were higher in the Av group and the OMV + Av group.

quote: TNF-α expression in the liver and IL-10 expression in the gill were both significantly higher in the OMV + Av group than in the Av group
statement: OMV + Av组肝脏中的TNF-α表达量和鳃中的IL-10表达量均显著高于Av组。
text_zh: OMV + Av组肝脏中的TNF-α表达量和鳃中的IL-10表达量均显著高于Av组。
text_en: TNF-α expression in the liver and IL-10 expression in the gills were both significantly higher in the OMV + Av group than in the Av group.

quote: A challenge protection test was conducted at 35 days post-primary immunization to evaluate vaccine efficacy (76).
statement: 在初次免疫后第35天进行攻毒保护试验以评估疫苗效力。
text_zh: 在初次免疫后第35天进行攻毒保护试验以评估疫苗效力。
text_en: A challenge protection test was conducted on day 35 after the initial immunization to evaluate vaccine efficacy.

quote: Twenty crucian carp from each group were randomly selected and intraperitoneally injected with 0.2 mL of A. veronii TH0426 suspension (2 × 10⁷ CFU/mL).
statement: 从每组随机选取20尾鲫鱼，腹腔注射0.2 mL维氏气单胞菌TH0426悬浮液（2 × 10⁷ CFU/mL）。
text_zh: 从每组随机选取20尾鲫鱼，腹腔注射0.2 mL维氏气单胞菌TH0426悬浮液（2 × 10⁷ CFU/mL）。

quote: The health status and mortality of the crucian carp were monitored daily for 14 consecutive days.
statement: 连续14天每天监测鲫鱼的健康状况和死亡率。
text_zh: 连续14天每天监测鲫鱼的健康状况和死亡率。
text_en: The health status and mortality of crucian carp were monitored daily for 14 consecutive days.

quote: The crucian carp were maintained in 200-L recirculating aquaria with controlled water parameters: temperature at 26 ± 1°C and dissolved oxygen at 6 mg/L.
statement: 鲫鱼被饲养在200升的循环水族箱中，水温控制在26±1°C，溶解氧为6 mg/L。
text_zh: 鲫鱼被饲养在200升的循环水族箱中，水温控制在26±1°C，溶解氧为6 mg/L。
text_en: Crucian carp were reared in 200-liter recirculating aquaria, with water temperature controlled at 26±1°C and dissolved oxygen at 6 mg/L.

quote: The crucian carp were fed twice daily with commercial extruded pellets (Tongwei, China) at 1% of total body weight.
statement: 鲫鱼每天喂食两次商业挤压颗粒饲料，投喂量为总体重的1%。
text_zh: 鲫鱼每天喂食两次商业挤压颗粒饲料，投喂量为总体重的1%。
text_en: Crucian carp were fed commercial extruded pellet feed twice daily at a rate of 1% of total body weight.

quote: One-third of the water volume was exchanged every 48 h, with water quality maintained by biological filtration coupled with ozone sterilization.
statement: 每48小时交换三分之一的水量，并通过生物过滤结合臭氧消毒来维持水质。
text_zh: 每48小时交换三分之一的水量，并通过生物过滤结合臭氧消毒来维持水质。
text_en: One-third of the water volume is exchanged every 48 hours, and water quality is maintained through biofiltration combined with ozone disinfection.

quote: The health status of the crucian carp was assessed daily through visual inspection of morphological characteristics, locomotor activity, and feeding response (58).
statement: 通过每日视觉检查形态特征、运动活动和摄食反应来评估鲫鱼的健康状况。
text_zh: 通过每日视觉检查形态特征、运动活动和摄食反应来评估鲫鱼的健康状况。
text_en: The health status of crucian carp is assessed by daily visual inspection of morphological features, locomotor activity, and feeding response.

quote: Following a 7-day acclimatization period under these conditions, the experimental procedures were initiated.
statement: 在这些条件下经过7天的适应期后，开始进行实验程序。
text_zh: 在这些条件下经过7天的适应期后，开始进行实验程序。
text_en: After a 7-day acclimation period under these conditions, the experimental procedures began.

quote: Ten crucian carp, which had been acclimated for 1 week, were selected to carry out the safety evaluation experiment (58) and were randomly divided into two groups, with five crucian carp in each group.
statement: 为了进行安全性评估实验，选择了十条经过一周驯化的鲫鱼，并随机分为两组，每组五条。
text_zh: 为了进行安全性评估实验，选择了十条经过一周驯化的鲫鱼，并随机分为两组，每组五条。
text_en: For the safety assessment experiment, ten crucian carp that had been acclimated for one week were selected and randomly divided into two groups of five each.

quote: The health status and mortality of the crucian carp were observed and recorded over a 2-week period.
statement: 在两周期间内观察并记录鲫鱼的健康状况和死亡率。
text_zh: 在两周期间内观察并记录鲫鱼的健康状况和死亡率。
text_en: The health status and mortality of crucian carp were observed and recorded over a two-week period.

quote: After 2 weeks, three crucian carp from each group were randomly selected, anesthetized, and dissected to collect tissues such as the liver, spleen, kidney, midgut, and gill.
statement: 两周后，从每组中随机选取三条鲫鱼，对其进行麻醉和解剖，以收集肝脏、脾脏、肾脏、中肠和鳃等组织。
text_zh: 两周后，从每组中随机选取三条鲫鱼，对其进行麻醉和解剖，以收集肝脏、脾脏、肾脏、中肠和鳃等组织。
text_en: Two weeks later, three crucian carp were randomly selected from each group and subjected to anesthesia and dissection to collect tissues such as liver, spleen, kidney, midgut, and gills.
outcome: 实验操作对动物的影响

quote: The histological changes in the main tissues of the test group and the PBS group were observed and analyzed.
statement: 观察并分析了试验组和PBS组主要组织的组织学变化。
text_zh: 观察并分析了试验组和PBS组主要组织的组织学变化。
text_en: Histological changes in major tissues of the experimental group and PBS group were observed and analyzed.

quote: Therefore, future studies need to screen for suitable novel adjuvants to replace CFA.
statement: 因此，未来的研究需要筛选合适的新型佐剂来替代CFA。
text_zh: 因此，未来的研究需要筛选合适的新型佐剂来替代CFA。
text_en: Therefore, future research needs to screen for suitable novel adjuvants to replace CFA.

quote: The induced increases in CAT and SOD levels effectively balanced reactive oxygen species (ROS) levels, while the elevated LZM levels strengthened bactericidal defense through enhanced lytic action (36 – 40).
statement: CAT和SOD水平的诱导性增加有效平衡了活性氧（ROS）水平，而升高的LZM水平通过增强裂解作用加强了杀菌防御。
text_zh: CAT和SOD水平的诱导性增加有效平衡了活性氧（ROS）水平，而升高的LZM水平通过增强裂解作用加强了杀菌防御。
text_en: The inducible increase in CAT and SOD levels effectively balanced reactive oxygen species (ROS) levels, while elevated LZM levels strengthened bactericidal defense by enhancing lysis.
outcome: 氧化应激平衡与杀菌防御

quote: Serum levels of complement components C3 and C4, as well as IgM, were significantly higher in all three experimental groups compared to the PBS group.
statement: 与PBS组相比，所有三个实验组的血清补体成分C3、C4以及IgM水平均显著升高。
text_zh: 与PBS组相比，所有三个实验组的血清补体成分C3、C4以及IgM水平均显著升高。
text_en: Compared with the PBS group, serum complement components C3 and C4 and IgM levels were significantly increased in all three experimental groups.

quote: Nonetheless, signs of brain cell death have been observed in the crucian carp after 7 days of anoxia with 1 day of reoxygenation, which was followed by increased mRNA abundance of proliferating cell nuclear antigen, a marker for neurogenesis (Lefevre et al., 2017).
statement: 尽管如此，在经历7天缺氧和1天复氧后，观察到鲫鱼脑部细胞死亡的迹象，随后增殖细胞核抗原（神经发生标志物）的mRNA丰度增加。
text_zh: 尽管如此，在经历7天缺氧和1天复氧后，观察到鲫鱼脑部细胞死亡的迹象，随后增殖细胞核抗原（神经发生标志物）的mRNA丰度增加。
text_en: Nevertheless, signs of cell death in the brain of crucian carp were observed after 7 days of hypoxia and 1 day of reoxygenation, followed by an increase in the mRNA abundance of proliferating cell nuclear antigen (a neurogenesis marker).
counterevidence: 观察到脑部细胞死亡迹象

quote: The peak expression of the anti-inflammatory cytokine IL-10 at day 28 and its predominant effect in the OMV + Av group suggest that it plays a role in maintaining immune balance by limiting excessive inflammatory damage (50 , 51).
statement: 抗炎细胞因子IL-10在第28天的峰值表达及其在OMV + Av组中的主导作用表明，它通过限制过度的炎症损伤在维持免疫平衡中发挥作用。
text_zh: 抗炎细胞因子IL-10在第28天的峰值表达及其在OMV + Av组中的主导作用表明，它通过限制过度的炎症损伤在维持免疫平衡中发挥作用。
text_en: The peak expression of the anti-inflammatory cytokine IL-10 on day 28 and its dominant role in the OMV + Av group indicate that it plays a role in maintaining immune balance by limiting excessive inflammatory damage.
outcome: 免疫平衡/炎症损伤控制

quote: The results of the challenge test showed that all experimental groups exhibited strong anti-infection ability.
statement: 攻毒试验结果显示所有实验组均表现出较强的抗感染能力。
text_zh: 攻毒试验结果显示所有实验组均表现出较强的抗感染能力。
text_en: The challenge test results showed that all experimental groups exhibited strong resistance to infection.

quote: Among them, the OMV + Av combination group achieved a relative percent survival (RPS) of 66%, which could effectively resist pathogenic bacterial infection.
statement: OMV + Av组合组的相对存活率（RPS）达到66%，能有效抵抗致病菌感染。
text_zh: OMV + Av组合组的相对存活率（RPS）达到66%，能有效抵抗致病菌感染。
text_en: The relative percent survival (RPS) of the OMV + Av combination group reached 66%, effectively resisting pathogenic bacterial infection.

quote: Relevant studies have reported that Zhang et al. used an inactivated A. veronii vaccine to immunize largemouth bass, resulting in an RPS of 56.67% (52)
statement: 相关研究报道Zhang等人使用灭活的维氏气单胞菌疫苗免疫大口黑鲈，RPS为56.67%。
text_zh: 相关研究报道Zhang等人使用灭活的维氏气单胞菌疫苗免疫大口黑鲈，RPS为56.67%。
text_en: Related studies reported that Zhang et al. immunized largemouth bass with an inactivated Aeromonas veronii vaccine, achieving a relative percent survival (RPS) of 56.67%.
intervention_record: 灭活维氏气单胞菌疫苗

quote: Feng et al. reported that after immunizing zebrafish with the live attenuated vaccine of Aeromonas dhakensis quadruple gene deletion mutant Δ aart , the RPS reached 56.67% (53)
statement: Feng等人报道用达坎气单胞菌四基因缺失突变体Δaart的减毒活疫苗免疫斑马鱼后，RPS达到56.67%。
text_zh: Feng等人报道用达坎气单胞菌四基因缺失突变体Δaart的减毒活疫苗免疫斑马鱼后，RPS达到56.67%。
text_en: Feng et al. reported that immunization of zebrafish with a live attenuated vaccine of the four-gene deletion mutant Δaart of Aeromonas dhakensis achieved an RPS of 56.67%.

quote: Yao et al. developed an aerolysin mutant subunit vaccine (GS115-Ntaer), with a challenge survival rate of only 33.43% in the zebrafish model (54).
statement: Yao等人开发了一种溶血素突变亚单位疫苗（GS115-Ntaer），在斑马鱼模型中的攻毒存活率仅为33.43%。
text_zh: Yao等人开发了一种溶血素突变亚单位疫苗（GS115-Ntaer），在斑马鱼模型中的攻毒存活率仅为33.43%。
text_en: Yao et al. developed a hemolysin mutant subunit vaccine (GS115-Ntaer), which had a challenge survival rate of only 33.43% in a zebrafish model.

quote: The above comparisons indicate that the combined immunization strategy of OMVs and inactivated A. veronii bacteria adopted in this study has obvious advantages in inducing host anti-infection immunity and can significantly enhance the immune protection level of crucian carp against A. veronii .
statement: 上述比较表明，本研究中采用的OMVs和灭活维氏气单胞菌联合免疫策略在诱导宿主抗感染免疫方面具有明显优势，并能显著提高鲫鱼对维氏气单胞菌的免疫保护水平。
text_zh: 上述比较表明，本研究中采用的OMVs和灭活维氏气单胞菌联合免疫策略在诱导宿主抗感染免疫方面具有明显优势，并能显著提高鲫鱼对维氏气单胞菌的免疫保护水平。
text_en: The above comparison indicates that the combined immunization strategy of OMVs and inactivated A. veronii adopted in this study has a clear advantage in inducing host anti-infection immunity, and can significantly improve the immune protection level of crucian carp against A. veronii.

quote: In this study, OMVs from A. veronii , administered alone or in combination with inactivated A. veronii vaccine, significantly upregulated the expression of TGF-β, TNF-α, IL-10, and IL-1β in various tissues of crucian carp.
statement: 本研究中，单独施用或与灭活维氏气单胞菌疫苗联合施用的维氏气单胞菌外膜囊泡（OMVs）显著上调了鲫鱼各组织中TGF-β、TNF-α、IL-10和IL-1β的表达。
text_zh: 本研究中，单独施用或与灭活维氏气单胞菌疫苗联合施用的维氏气单胞菌外膜囊泡（OMVs）显著上调了鲫鱼各组织中TGF-β、TNF-α、IL-10和IL-1β的表达。
text_en: In this study, outer membrane vesicles (OMVs) from A. veronii, administered alone or combined with an inactivated A. veronii vaccine, significantly upregulated the expression of TGF-β, TNF-α, IL-10 and IL-1β in various tissues of crucian carp.
outcome: 免疫反应/细胞因子表达

quote: The sustained high expression in the OMV + Av group indicates its potential role in maintaining immune homeostasis by balancing pro-inflammatory and anti-inflammatory responses (45).
statement: OMV + Av组中持续的高表达表明其通过平衡促炎和抗炎反应在维持免疫稳态方面的潜在作用。
text_zh: OMV + Av组中持续的高表达表明其通过平衡促炎和抗炎反应在维持免疫稳态方面的潜在作用。
text_en: The sustained high expression in the OMV + Av group indicates its potential role in maintaining immune homeostasis by balancing pro-inflammatory and anti-inflammatory responses.

quote: Reoxygenating a previously oxygen-deprived tissue presents a unique challenge. While recovering aerobic respiration rate as soon as possible would allow mitochondria to resume normoxic ATP production levels, this could come at the potential cost of hazardous generation rates of reactive oxygen species (ROS), specifically at the mitochondrial complex I ROS generation site (Murphy, 2009).
statement: 对先前缺氧的组织进行复氧是一个独特的挑战，虽然尽快恢复有氧呼吸速率可以让线粒体恢复正常ATP产生水平，但这可能以线粒体复合I位点产生危险水平的活性氧（ROS）为代价。
text_zh: 对先前缺氧的组织进行复氧是一个独特的挑战，虽然尽快恢复有氧呼吸速率可以让线粒体恢复正常ATP产生水平，但这可能以线粒体复合I位点产生危险水平的活性氧（ROS）为代价。
text_en: Reoxygenation of previously hypoxic tissue is a unique challenge; although restoring aerobic respiration rates as quickly as possible allows mitochondria to return to normal ATP production levels, this may come at the cost of dangerous levels of reactive oxygen species (ROS) generated at mitochondrial complex I sites.

population.species: 通用模型/哺乳动物类比

outcome: 氧化应激与组织损伤风险

quote: Mitochondrial H 2 O 2 generation measured in vivo was unaffected by anoxia–reoxygenation exposure in heart, brain and gill, but reduced by ∼25% in liver.
statement: 体内测量的线粒体过氧化氢生成在心脏、大脑和鳃中不受缺氧-复氧暴露的影响，但在肝脏中减少了约25%。
text_zh: 体内测量的线粒体过氧化氢生成在心脏、大脑和鳃中不受缺氧-复氧暴露的影响，但在肝脏中减少了约25%。
text_en: In vivo measured mitochondrial hydrogen peroxide production was unaffected by hypoxia-reoxygenation exposure in the heart, brain, and gills, but decreased by about 25% in the liver.

quote: There were also tissue-specific increases in protein carbonylation (∼1.8-fold in brain and gills) and mitochondrial DNA (mtDNA) damage (∼1.5-fold in liver and heart), indicating that biphasic oxidative stress responses affect tissues differently.
statement: 蛋白质羰基化（大脑和鳃增加约1.8倍）和线粒体DNA损伤（肝脏和心脏增加约1.5倍）存在组织特异性增加，表明双相氧化应激反应对不同组织的影响不同。
text_zh: 蛋白质羰基化（大脑和鳃增加约1.8倍）和线粒体DNA损伤（肝脏和心脏增加约1.5倍）存在组织特异性增加，表明双相氧化应激反应对不同组织的影响不同。
text_en: There were tissue-specific increases in protein carbonylation (about 1.8-fold increase in the brain and gills) and mitochondrial DNA damage (about 1.5-fold increase in the liver and heart), indicating that the biphasic oxidative stress response affects different tissues differently.

quote: crucian carp stay relatively active (albeit reducing swimming activity) and maintain brain function (Lefevre et al., 2017 ; Nilsson, 2001) and cardiac output (Stecyk et al., 2004) during anoxic periods.
statement: 鲫鱼在缺氧期间保持相对活跃（尽管游泳活动减少），并维持脑功能和心输出量。
text_zh: 鲫鱼在缺氧期间保持相对活跃（尽管游泳活动减少），并维持脑功能和心输出量。
text_en: Crucian carp remain relatively active during hypoxia (although swimming activity decreases) and maintain brain function and cardiac output.
outcome: 缺氧期间的生理功能维持

quote: Approximately 20–50 mg of frozen tissue (brain, heart, gill and liver from crucian carp exposed to anoxia–reoxygenation; exposure B) was homogenized in 210 µl ice-cold 60% acetonitrile/0.1% formic
statement: 来自暴露于缺氧-复氧处理的鲫鱼脑、心脏、鳃和肝脏的冷冻组织被均质化以进行线粒体H2O2生成的体内测量。
text_zh: 来自暴露于缺氧-复氧处理的鲫鱼脑、心脏、鳃和肝脏的冷冻组织被均质化以进行线粒体H2O2生成的体内测量。
text_en: Frozen tissues from the brain, heart, gills, and liver of crucian carp exposed to hypoxia-reoxygenation treatment were homogenized for in vivo measurement of mitochondrial H2O2 production.

quote: Two fish were removed from each of the two control (5 days of normoxia, N) and two AR (5 days of anoxia, A; 5 days of anoxia with 3 h reoxygenation, AR3h; 5 days of anoxia with 6 h reoxygenation, AR6h) set-ups at three time points and sampled.
statement: 研究对处于常氧、缺氧以及不同时间复氧条件下的鱼进行了采样，以分析其组织样本。
text_zh: 研究对处于常氧、缺氧以及不同时间复氧条件下的鱼进行了采样，以分析其组织样本。
text_en: Fish were sampled under normoxia, hypoxia, and different reoxygenation durations to analyze their tissue samples.

quote: Fish (total N =48; n =12 per treatment) were sampled after (1) 5 days of normoxia (N), (2) 5 days of anoxia (A), (3) 5 days of anoxia with 3 h reoxygenation (AR3h) and (4) 5 days of anoxia with 6 h reoxygenation (AR6h).
statement: 在常氧、缺氧及不同时长复氧处理后采集鱼样，用于表征氧化损伤。
text_zh: 在常氧、缺氧及不同时长复氧处理后采集鱼样，用于表征氧化损伤。
text_en: Fish samples were collected after normoxia, hypoxia, and reoxygenation treatments of different durations to characterize oxidative damage.

quote: Crucian carp (39.44±1.86 g) of both sexes were placed in 25 l buckets (up to 12 fish in each bucket) which were filled with dechlorinated tap water and sealed with airtight lids.
statement: 鲫鱼被放置在装有脱氯自来水的密封桶中，每桶最多12条鱼。
text_zh: 鲫鱼被放置在装有脱氯自来水的密封桶中，每桶最多12条鱼。
text_en: Crucian carp were placed in sealed buckets containing dechlorinated tap water, with a maximum of 12 fish per bucket.

quote: These exposure buckets were submerged in a water bath with connected chillers to maintain temperature at 8°C.
statement: 暴露桶浸没在连接冷却器的水浴中以维持8°C的温度。
text_zh: 暴露桶浸没在连接冷却器的水浴中以维持8°C的温度。
text_en: The exposure bucket was immersed in a water bath connected to a cooler to maintain a temperature of 8°C.

quote: Fish were left in the buckets with air bubbling for 24 h prior to the start of the experiment to recover from handling.
statement: 鱼在实验开始前在充气的桶中停留24小时以从处理中恢复。
text_zh: 鱼在实验开始前在充气的桶中停留24小时以从处理中恢复。
text_en: Fish were held in aerated buckets for 24 hours before the start of the experiment to recover from handling.

quote: A total of 160 crucian carp were randomly divided into four groups, with 40 crucian carp per group.
statement: 将160尾鲫鱼随机分为四组，每组40尾。
text_zh: 将160尾鲫鱼随机分为四组，每组40尾。
text_en: 160 crucian carp were randomly divided into four groups, with 40 fish per group.

quote: All crucian carp were fasted for 24 h prior to sampling (64 , 65).
statement: 所有鲫鱼在采样前禁食24小时。
text_zh: 所有鲫鱼在采样前禁食24小时。
text_en: All crucian carp were fasted for 24 hours before sampling.

quote: The crucian carp were then anesthetized, and blood was collected from the caudal vein.
statement: 随后对鲫鱼进行麻醉，并从尾静脉采血。
text_zh: 随后对鲫鱼进行麻醉，并从尾静脉采血。
text_en: Crucian carp were then anesthetized, and blood was collected from the caudal vein.

quote: 4-hydroxynonenal (4-HNE) modifications of protein were assessed in crucian carp liver (50 µg protein/well), heart (20 µg protein/well), brain (50 µg protein/well) and gills (25 µg protein/well) exposed to anoxia–reoxygenation (exposure C) via western blotting
statement: 通过蛋白质印迹法评估了暴露于缺氧-复氧（暴露C）的鲫鱼肝脏、心脏、大脑和鳃中的4-羟基壬烯醛（4-HNE）蛋白修饰。
text_zh: 通过蛋白质印迹法评估了暴露于缺氧-复氧（暴露C）的鲫鱼肝脏、心脏、大脑和鳃中的4-羟基壬烯醛（4-HNE）蛋白修饰。
text_en: 4-hydroxynonenal (4-HNE) protein modifications in the liver, heart, brain and gills of crucian carp exposed to hypoxia-reoxygenation (exposure C) were assessed by Western blotting.
outcome: 脂质过氧化/氧化应激标志物检测

quote: ups introduced into protein by oxidative reactions were detected and quantified using Abcam's Oxidized Protein Western Blot Detection Kit (ab178020).
statement: 使用Abcam的氧化蛋白Western Blot检测试剂盒（ab178020）来检测和量化由氧化反应引入蛋白质中的羰基。
text_zh: 使用Abcam的氧化蛋白Western Blot检测试剂盒（ab178020）来检测和量化由氧化反应引入蛋白质中的羰基。
text_en: The Oxidized Protein Western Blot Detection Kit (ab178020) from Abcam was used to detect and quantify carbonyls introduced into proteins by oxidation reactions.

quote: The resulting sample extracts were used for detection of both protein damage (detection of carbonyl groups) and lipid peroxidation (detection of 4-hydroxynonenal; 4-HNE).
statement: 所得样品提取物用于检测蛋白质损伤（羰基检测）和脂质过氧化（4-羟基壬烯醛；4-HNE检测）。
text_zh: 所得样品提取物用于检测蛋白质损伤（羰基检测）和脂质过氧化（4-羟基壬烯醛；4-HNE检测）。
text_en: The obtained sample extracts were used to detect protein damage (carbonyl assay) and lipid peroxidation (4-hydroxynonenal; 4-HNE assay).
intervention: Protein damage and lipid peroxidation detection
intervention_record: 蛋白损伤与脂质过氧化检测

quote: we predicted that crucian carp would show a persistent reduction in complex II activity (i.e. enzymatic activity and mitochondrial respiratory capacity or flux) as an adaptative response to anoxia–reoxygenation exposure, as suggested by previous studies in other hypoxia-tolerant species
statement: 作者预测，作为对缺氧-复氧暴露的适应性反应，鲫鱼会表现出复合体II活性的持续降低，这与之前在其他耐缺氧物种中的研究结果一致。
text_zh: 作者预测，作为对缺氧-复氧暴露的适应性反应，鲫鱼会表现出复合体II活性的持续降低，这与之前在其他耐缺氧物种中的研究结果一致。
text_en: The authors predict that, as an adaptive response to anoxia–reoxygenation exposure, crucian carp will exhibit a sustained decrease in complex II activity, consistent with previous findings in other hypoxia-tolerant species.
outcome: 线粒体呼吸能力/酶活性

quote: Finally, we investigated whether crucian carp were able to minimize mitochondrial H 2 O 2 generation and hence tissue accumulation and expected that there would be limited oxidative tissue damage after whole-animal anoxia–reoxygenation exposure.
statement: 最后，作者研究了鲫鱼是否能最小化线粒体H2O2的产生及随后的组织积累，并预期在全动物缺氧-复氧暴露后氧化组织损伤有限。
text_zh: 最后，作者研究了鲫鱼是否能最小化线粒体H2O2的产生及随后的组织积累，并预期在全动物缺氧-复氧暴露后氧化组织损伤有限。
text_en: Finally, the authors investigated whether crucian carp can minimize mitochondrial H2O2 production and subsequent tissue accumulation, expecting limited oxidative tissue damage after whole-animal anoxia–reoxygenation exposure.

quote: First, DNA was extracted from whole brain, heart, gill and liver tissues from crucian carp exposed to anoxia–reoxygenation (exposure C) with the Qiagen DNeasy Blood and Tissue Kit (Qiagen, Hilden, Germany) following the manufacturer's protocol.
statement: 首先，使用Qiagen血液和组织DNeasy试剂盒从暴露于缺氧-复氧（暴露C）的鲫鱼全脑、心脏、鳃和肝脏组织中提取DNA。
text_zh: 首先，使用Qiagen血液和组织DNeasy试剂盒从暴露于缺氧-复氧（暴露C）的鲫鱼全脑、心脏、鳃和肝脏组织中提取DNA。
text_en: First, DNA was extracted from whole brain, heart, gill and liver tissues of crucian carp exposed to hypoxia-reoxygenation (exposure C) using the Qiagen Blood and Tissue DNeasy kit.

quote: The agglutination results were observed, the experiment was repeated three times, and the serum antibody titer was analyzed with reference to relevant literature (67 , 68).
statement: 观察凝集结果，重复实验三次，并参考相关文献分析血清抗体滴度。
text_zh: 观察凝集结果，重复实验三次，并参考相关文献分析血清抗体滴度。
text_en: Observe the agglutination results, repeat the experiment three times, and analyze serum antibody titers with reference to relevant literature.

quote: Fire sting fibre-optic O 2 probes (Pyroscience GmBH, Aachen, Germany) were inserted into a second opening in the bucket lid to monitor O 2 levels inside the bucket for the duration of the experiment.
statement: 使用光纤氧气探头插入桶盖的第二个开口，以在整个实验期间监测桶内的氧气水平。
text_zh: 使用光纤氧气探头插入桶盖的第二个开口，以在整个实验期间监测桶内的氧气水平。
text_en: A fiber optic oxygen probe was inserted into the second opening of the bucket lid to monitor oxygen levels in the bucket throughout the experiment.

quote: To initiate the anoxic exposure, N 2 gas was bubbled into the bucket and anoxia (2 gas supply was substituted for aeration and the O 2 levels in the bucket returned to normoxic levels within 1–2 h.
statement: 通过向桶内通入氮气引发缺氧暴露，随后将氮气供应替换为曝气，使桶内氧气水平在1-2小时内恢复到常氧水平。
text_zh: 通过向桶内通入氮气引发缺氧暴露，随后将氮气供应替换为曝气，使桶内氧气水平在1-2小时内恢复到常氧水平。
text_en: Hypoxia exposure was induced by bubbling nitrogen into the buckets, followed by replacing the nitrogen supply with aeration to restore oxygen levels in the buckets to normoxic levels within 1-2 hours.

quote: Fish were netted out and euthanized via concussion followed by spinal severance.
statement: 鱼被网出并通过震荡致昏后切断脊髓进行安乐死。
text_zh: 鱼被网出并通过震荡致昏后切断脊髓进行安乐死。
text_en: Fish were netted and euthanized by spinal cord transection after stunning by vibration.

quote: Multiple anoxia–reoxygenation exposures were performed, with only a few fish exposed at a time, over several weeks (for a total of N =18 fish; n =6 per treatment).
statement: 进行了多次缺氧-复氧暴露，每次仅暴露少量鱼，持续数周（总共N=18条鱼；每组n=6）。
text_zh: 进行了多次缺氧-复氧暴露，每次仅暴露少量鱼，持续数周（总共N=18条鱼；每组n=6）。
text_en: Multiple hypoxia-reoxygenation exposures were conducted, with only a small number of fish exposed each time, lasting for several weeks (total N=18 fish; n=6 per group).

quote: Fish were housed at the in vivo aquatic facilities at the Department of Biosciences, University of Oslo, in semi-closed recirculating tanks supplied with dechlorinated tap water.
statement: 鱼类被饲养在奥斯陆大学生物科学系的半封闭循环水箱中，使用去氯自来水。
text_zh: 鱼类被饲养在奥斯陆大学生物科学系的半封闭循环水箱中，使用去氯自来水。
text_en: Fish were reared in semi-closed recirculating tanks at the Department of Biosciences, University of Oslo, using dechlorinated tap water.

population.species: 鲫鱼 (Crucian carp) 和鲤鱼 (Common carp)

quote: Fish were maintained at 12–14°C with a 12 h light:12 h dark photoperiod and fed carp pellets daily (Tetra Pond, Melle, Germany).
statement: 鱼类维持在12-14°C，光照周期为12小时明/12小时暗，并每日投喂鲤鱼饲料颗粒。
text_zh: 鱼类维持在12-14°C，光照周期为12小时明/12小时暗，并每日投喂鲤鱼饲料颗粒。
text_en: Fish were maintained at 12-14°C, with a light cycle of 12 hours light/12 hours dark, and fed carp feed pellets daily.

population.species: 鲫鱼 (Crucian carp) 和鲤鱼 (Common carp)

quote: Fish were acclimated to lab conditions for a minimum of 2 weeks and were fasted 24 h immediately prior to anoxia–reoxygenation exposure.
statement: 鱼类至少适应实验室条件2周，并在缺氧-复氧暴露前禁食24小时。
text_zh: 鱼类至少适应实验室条件2周，并在缺氧-复氧暴露前禁食24小时。
text_en: Fish were acclimated to laboratory conditions for at least 2 weeks and fasted for 24 hours prior to hypoxia-reoxygenation exposure.

population.species: 鲫鱼 (Crucian carp) 和鲤鱼 (Common carp)

quote: The holding temperature was lowered over a couple of days to 8°C, 1 week prior to anoxia exposure.
statement: 在缺氧暴露前一周，饲养温度在几天内降低至8°C。
text_zh: 在缺氧暴露前一周，饲养温度在几天内降低至8°C。
text_en: One week before hypoxia exposure, the rearing temperature was lowered to 8°C over a period of several days.

population.species: 鲫鱼 (Crucian carp) 和鲤鱼 (Common carp)

quote: All experimental protocols were approved by the Norwegian Food Safety Authority (FOTS permit ID 16063), in accordance with the animal welfare law of Norway (‘Dyrevelferdsloven’) and instructions on use of animals for research (‘Forskrift om bruk av dyr i forsøk’).
statement: 所有实验方案均经挪威食品安全局批准，符合挪威动物福利法及相关研究用动物规定。
text_zh: 所有实验方案均经挪威食品安全局批准，符合挪威动物福利法及相关研究用动物规定。
text_en: All experimental protocols were approved by the Norwegian Food Safety Authority, in compliance with the Norwegian Animal Welfare Act and related regulations for research animals.

population.species: 鲫鱼 (Crucian carp) 和鲤鱼 (Common carp)

quote: In contrast, heart mitochondria from crucian carp exposed to 5 days of anoxia with 1 day of reoxygenation showed significantly decreased complex II flux compared with fish under normoxia and anoxia (Fig. 4C), but no differences in complex II capacity between the treatment groups (Fig. 4D).
statement: 相比之下，暴露于5天缺氧加1天复氧的鲫鱼心脏线粒体，其复合体II通量与常氧和单纯缺氧组相比显著降低，但各组间复合体II容量无差异。
text_zh: 相比之下，暴露于5天缺氧加1天复氧的鲫鱼心脏线粒体，其复合体II通量与常氧和单纯缺氧组相比显著降低，但各组间复合体II容量无差异。
text_en: In contrast, the complex II flux in heart mitochondria of crucian carp exposed to 5 days of hypoxia plus 1 day of reoxygenation was significantly lower compared to the normoxia and hypoxia-only groups, but there was no difference in complex II capacity among the groups.

quote: No differences in brain enzymatic activity for the five mitochondrial complexes were found between treatment groups (Fig. 5A–E).
statement: 各处理组之间脑组织五种线粒体复合体的酶活性未发现差异。
text_zh: 各处理组之间脑组织五种线粒体复合体的酶活性未发现差异。
text_en: No differences were found in the enzyme activities of five mitochondrial complexes in brain tissue among the treatment groups.
outcome: 脑线粒体复合体酶活性

quote: For exposure B, a smaller 10 l bucket was placed inside the same 25 l buckets used in exposures A and C. This smaller inner bucket had two large mesh windows on the side such that anoxic fish could be removed from the outer exposure bucket while still being submerged in 4 l anoxic water in the smaller bucket.
statement: 对于暴露B，将一个较小的10升桶放入用于暴露A和C的相同25升桶中。这个较小的内桶侧面有两个大的网状窗口，使得可以在不将鱼从外暴露桶中取出的情况下，让鱼仍浸没在小桶内的4升缺氧水中。
text_zh: 对于暴露B，将一个较小的10升桶放入用于暴露A和C的相同25升桶中。这个较小的内桶侧面有两个大的网状窗口，使得可以在不将鱼从外暴露桶中取出的情况下，让鱼仍浸没在小桶内的4升缺氧水中。
text_en: For exposure B, a smaller 10-liter bucket was placed inside the same 25-liter bucket used for exposures A and C. This smaller inner bucket had two large mesh windows on its sides, allowing the fish to remain immersed in the 4 liters of hypoxic water within the small bucket without being removed from the outer exposure bucket.

quote: This set-up minimized disturbance to the fish and prevented air exposure of the fish prior to anaesthesia for injection of the MitoB probe.
statement: 该设置最大限度地减少了对鱼的干扰，并防止了在麻醉以注射MitoB探针之前鱼暴露在空气中。
text_zh: 该设置最大限度地减少了对鱼的干扰，并防止了在麻醉以注射MitoB探针之前鱼暴露在空气中。
text_en: This setup minimizes disturbance to the fish and prevents exposure of the fish to air before anesthesia for MitoB probe injection.

quote: Submerged anoxic fish were lightly anaesthetized with 50 mg l −1 benzocaine, briefly removed one by one for injection of MitoB and immediately returned into the larger exposure bucket.
statement: 浸没在缺氧水中的鱼用50 mg/l的苯佐卡因轻度麻醉，逐一短暂取出以注射MitoB，然后立即放回较大的暴露桶中。
text_zh: 浸没在缺氧水中的鱼用50 mg/l的苯佐卡因轻度麻醉，逐一短暂取出以注射MitoB，然后立即放回较大的暴露桶中。
text_en: Fish immersed in hypoxic water were lightly anesthetized with 50 mg/l benzocaine, briefly removed one by one to inject MitoB, and then immediately returned to larger exposure buckets.
intervention_record: 苯佐卡因麻醉及快速注射

quote: There were no differences between sampling time points in either the normoxic controls or the anoxia-exposed treatment groups.
statement: 在常氧对照组或缺氧暴露处理组中，不同采样时间点之间均无差异。
text_zh: 在常氧对照组或缺氧暴露处理组中，不同采样时间点之间均无差异。
text_en: There was no difference between different sampling time points in either the normoxia control group or the hypoxia exposure treatment group.
outcome: 体内线粒体过氧化氢生成的时间稳定性

quote: In the brain and gills, there were no differences in the level of mtDNA damage between treatment groups (Fig. 8A,C).
statement: 在脑和鳃中，不同处理组之间的线粒体DNA损伤水平没有差异。
text_zh: 在脑和鳃中，不同处理组之间的线粒体DNA损伤水平没有差异。
text_en: In the brain and gills, there was no difference in mitochondrial DNA damage levels between different treatment groups.

quote: In the heart, however, there was a significantly higher level of mtDNA damage in both the anoxic (A) and 6 h reoxygenated (AR6h) treatment groups compared with the normoxic controls, whereas the levels at 3 h reoxygenation (AR3h) were intermediate (Fig. 8B).
statement: 在心脏中，与常氧对照组相比，缺氧组和6小时复氧组的线粒体DNA损伤水平显著升高，而3小时复氧组的水平处于中间值。
text_zh: 在心脏中，与常氧对照组相比，缺氧组和6小时复氧组的线粒体DNA损伤水平显著升高，而3小时复氧组的水平处于中间值。
text_en: In the heart, mitochondrial DNA damage levels were significantly higher in the hypoxia group and the 6-hour reoxygenation group compared to the normoxic control group, while the level in the 3-hour reoxygenation group was intermediate.

quote: In the liver, mtDNA damage was significantly higher in the anoxic treatment group compared with the normoxic controls, whereas the AR3h and AR6h treatment groups had intermediate values (Fig. 8D).
statement: 在肝脏中，与常氧对照组相比，缺氧处理组的线粒体DNA损伤显著更高，而3小时和6小时复氧处理组的数值处于中间水平。
text_zh: 在肝脏中，与常氧对照组相比，缺氧处理组的线粒体DNA损伤显著更高，而3小时和6小时复氧处理组的数值处于中间水平。
text_en: In the liver, mitochondrial DNA damage was significantly higher in the hypoxia-treated group compared to the normoxic control group, while the values for the 3-hour and 6-hour reoxygenation groups were at intermediate levels.

quote: As an attempt to investigate potential lipid oxidative damage, we quantified levels of the lipid peroxidation product 4-hydroxynonenal (4-HNE), but there were no detectable levels of 4-HNE in any of the tissues analysed (Fig. S3).
statement: 为了调查潜在的脂质氧化损伤，我们量化了脂质过氧化产物4-羟基壬烯醛（4-HNE）的水平，但在任何分析的组织中均未检测到4-HNE。
text_zh: 为了调查潜在的脂质氧化损伤，我们量化了脂质过氧化产物4-羟基壬烯醛（4-HNE）的水平，但在任何分析的组织中均未检测到4-HNE。
text_en: To investigate potential lipid oxidative damage, we quantified the levels of the lipid peroxidation product 4-hydroxynonenal (4-HNE), but no 4-HNE was detected in any of the analyzed tissues.

quote: In the brain, heart and gill tissues, there was a significant effect of experimental treatment on levels of protein carbonylation, a marker of protein damage (Fig. 7).
statement: 实验处理对脑、心脏和鳃组织中的蛋白质羰基化水平（蛋白质损伤标志物）有显著影响。
text_zh: 实验处理对脑、心脏和鳃组织中的蛋白质羰基化水平（蛋白质损伤标志物）有显著影响。
text_en: The experimental treatment had a significant effect on protein carbonylation levels (a marker of protein damage) in brain, heart, and gill tissues.

quote: In the gills, however, the levels of protein carbonylation continued to increase up to 6 h of reoxygenation (AR6h), with intermediate oxidation at anoxia and 3 h reoxygenation (Fig. 7C).
statement: 在鳃部，蛋白质羰基化水平持续增加直至复氧6小时，而在缺氧和复氧3小时时处于中等氧化水平。
text_zh: 在鳃部，蛋白质羰基化水平持续增加直至复氧6小时，而在缺氧和复氧3小时时处于中等氧化水平。
text_en: In the gills, protein carbonylation levels continued to increase until 6 hours of reoxygenation, while being at moderate oxidation levels during hypoxia and at 3 hours of reoxygenation.

quote: The low ROS production could partly be explained by higher total oxidant scavenging capacity.
statement: 较低的活性氧产生可能部分归因于较高的总氧化剂清除能力。
text_zh: 较低的活性氧产生可能部分归因于较高的总氧化剂清除能力。
text_en: Lower reactive oxygen species production may be partly attributed to higher total oxidant scavenging capacity.

quote: Crucian carp exposed to anoxia–reoxygenation showed no differences in brain mitochondrial complex enzymatic activities (Fig. 5A–E) but after 1 day of reoxygenation, both complexes II and V in heart tissue showed decreases in activity (Fig. 5G,J).
statement: 暴露于缺氧-复氧的鲫鱼脑线粒体复合酶活性无差异，但复氧1天后心脏组织中的复合体II和V活性均降低。
text_zh: 暴露于缺氧-复氧的鲫鱼脑线粒体复合酶活性无差异，但复氧1天后心脏组织中的复合体II和V活性均降低。
text_en: There was no difference in brain mitochondrial complex enzyme activity in crucian carp exposed to anoxia–reoxygenation, but the activities of Complex II and V in heart tissue decreased after 1 day of reoxygenation.

quote: Despite the low accumulation of ROS (as assessed by H 2 O 2 levels in vitro and in vivo), our results indicate that crucian carp exhibit changes in some markers of oxidative stress, as we observed tissue-specific increases in protein carbonylation (Fig. 7) and mtDNA damage (Fig. 8) levels.
statement: 尽管活性氧积累较低（通过体外和体内H2O2水平评估），我们的结果表明鲫鱼表现出一些氧化应激标志物的变化，因为我们观察到蛋白质羰基化和mtDNA损伤水平的组织特异性增加。
text_zh: 尽管活性氧积累较低（通过体外和体内H2O2水平评估），我们的结果表明鲫鱼表现出一些氧化应激标志物的变化，因为我们观察到蛋白质羰基化和mtDNA损伤水平的组织特异性增加。
text_en: Although reactive oxygen species accumulation was low (assessed by in vitro and in vivo H2O2 levels), our results indicate that crucian carp exhibited changes in some oxidative stress markers, as we observed tissue-specific increases in protein carbonylation and mtDNA damage levels.
outcome: 氧化应激标志物（蛋白质羰基化、mtDNA损伤）

quote: There was a general decrease in MitoP/MitoB ratio with anoxia–reoxygenation exposure compared with normoxic controls at the same sampling point (although this was only significant in the liver; Fig. 6D).
statement: 与同一采样点的常氧对照组相比，缺氧-复氧暴露组的MitoP/MitoB比值普遍下降，但仅在肝脏中具有统计学显著性。
text_zh: 与同一采样点的常氧对照组相比，缺氧-复氧暴露组的MitoP/MitoB比值普遍下降，但仅在肝脏中具有统计学显著性。
text_en: Compared to the normoxia control group at the same sampling site, the MitoP/MitoB ratio generally decreased in the hypoxia-reoxygenation exposure group, but statistical significance was only observed in the liver.
outcome: 体内线粒体过氧化氢水平

statement: 正常游泳的实验性破坏，例如斑马鱼的尾部切除，会导致...
text_zh: 正常游泳的实验性破坏，例如斑马鱼的尾部切除，会导致...
text_en: Experimental disruption of normal swimming, such as tail amputation in zebrafish, leads to...

quote: Paramecia were fed to the larvae starting at 7 dpf, and from 14 dpf, the larvae were fed with brine shrimps and simultaneously transferred to the zebrafish rearing system.
statement: 斑马鱼幼体从7日龄开始投喂草履虫，从14日龄开始投喂卤虫并转入养殖系统。
text_zh: 斑马鱼幼体从7日龄开始投喂草履虫，从14日龄开始投喂卤虫并转入养殖系统。
text_en: Zebrafish larvae are fed Paramecium starting from 7 days post-fertilization, and Artemia starting from 14 days post-fertilization, at which point they are transferred to the rearing system.

quote: We then investigated whether crucian carp exposed to anoxia–reoxygenation show plastic mitochondrial responses that would further help to alleviate reoxygenation stress (Figs 4 and 5), expecting that there would be a decrease in complex II activities (i.e. enzymatic activity and/or mitochondrial flux or capacity) in both brain and heart mitochondria in response to anoxia
statement: 研究人员调查了暴露于缺氧-复氧环境的鲫鱼是否表现出有助于缓解复氧应激的可塑性线粒体反应，并预期在缺氧条件下其大脑和心脏线粒体的复合物II活性会降低。
text_zh: 研究人员调查了暴露于缺氧-复氧环境的鲫鱼是否表现出有助于缓解复氧应激的可塑性线粒体反应，并预期在缺氧条件下其大脑和心脏线粒体的复合物II活性会降低。
text_en: Researchers investigated whether crucian carp exposed to hypoxia-reoxygenation environments exhibit plastic mitochondrial responses that help alleviate reoxygenation stress, and expected that complex II activity in the brain and heart mitochondria would decrease under hypoxic conditions.

quote: To investigate how the proteome of crucian carp changes with oxygen depletion and reoxygenation, we exposed crucian carp to five days normoxia, five days anoxia
statement: 为了研究鲫鱼蛋白质组如何随氧气耗尽和复氧而变化，将鲫鱼暴露于五天常氧和五天缺氧条件下。
text_zh: 为了研究鲫鱼蛋白质组如何随氧气耗尽和复氧而变化，将鲫鱼暴露于五天常氧和五天缺氧条件下。
text_en: To study how the proteome of crucian carp changes with oxygen depletion and reoxygenation, crucian carp were exposed to five days of normoxia and five days of hypoxia.

quote: Crucian carp can withstand at least two weeks of anoxic exposure at 8 °C (Nilsson, 1990) and no mortality was observed during the experiment.
statement: 鲫鱼在8°C下可耐受至少两周的缺氧暴露，且本实验期间未观察到死亡。
text_zh: 鲫鱼在8°C下可耐受至少两周的缺氧暴露，且本实验期间未观察到死亡。
text_en: Crucian carp can tolerate at least two weeks of anoxic exposure at 8°C, and no deaths were observed during this experiment.

quote: Fish were euthanized by a quick blow to the head, the spinal cord was cut and brain, heart and liver tissues were dissected out in the mentioned order.
statement: 鱼通过快速击打头部进行安乐死，切断脊髓并按顺序解剖出脑、心脏和肝脏组织。
text_zh: 鱼通过快速击打头部进行安乐死，切断脊髓并按顺序解剖出脑、心脏和肝脏组织。
text_en: Fish were euthanized by a rapid blow to the head, severing the spinal cord, and brain, heart, and liver tissues were dissected out in sequence.

quote: The fish were fed daily with commercial carp food (Tetrapond, Tetra, Melle, Germany), and acclimatized to indoor conditions for at least four weeks prior to exposure.
statement: Fish were fed daily with commercial carp food and acclimatized to indoor conditions for at least four weeks before exposure.
text_en: Fish were fed daily with commercial carp food and acclimatized to indoor conditions for at least four weeks before exposure.

quote: Prior to anoxia exposure, randomly selected crucian carp of both sex (n = 18, weight = 27 ± 8 g) were transferred to separate, 25-liter lightproof containers, starved and acclimatized for 48 h in aerated water flowing through the tanks.
statement: Crucian carp were transferred to lightproof containers, starved, and acclimatized for 48 hours in aerated water before anoxia exposure.
text_en: Crucian carp were transferred to lightproof containers, starved, and acclimatized for 48 hours in aerated water before anoxia exposure.

quote: Anoxia was achieved by continuous low bubbling of nitrogen, and the oxygen level monitored using a Firesting fiber-optic oxygen meter with an oxygen probe (PyroScience GmbH, Aachen, Germany) to ensure that oxygen levels never exceeded 0.1% of air saturation (2).
statement: Anoxia was induced by nitrogen bubbling while monitoring oxygen levels to keep them below 0.1% air saturation.
text_en: Anoxia was induced by nitrogen bubbling while monitoring oxygen levels to keep them below 0.1% air saturation.

quote: To date, there is only one report using a discovery-driven proteomic approach on the Carassius heart, showing that aldolases may contribute to a balance between glycolysis and gluconeogenesis during hypoxia (Imbrogno et al., 2019).
statement: 迄今为止，只有一项关于Carassius心脏的发现驱动蛋白质组学方法的报告，显示醛缩酶可能在缺氧期间有助于糖酵解和糖异生之间的平衡。
text_zh: 迄今为止，只有一项关于Carassius心脏的发现驱动蛋白质组学方法的报告，显示醛缩酶可能在缺氧期间有助于糖酵解和糖异生之间的平衡。
text_en: To date, only one report on proteomics findings driving Carassius heart research has shown that aldolase may help balance glycolysis and gluconeogenesis during hypoxia.
outcome: cardiac metabolic regulation under low oxygen
limitations: qualitative study performed on hypoxia-exposed goldfish

quote: In the brain, glycogen synthase was the only protein that changed during anoxia and reoxygenation, increasing 3-fold in both anoxia and reoxygenation compared to normoxia (File S1).
statement: 在大脑中，糖原合酶是缺氧和复氧期间唯一发生变化的蛋白质，与常氧相比，在缺氧和复氧期间均增加了3倍。
text_zh: 在大脑中，糖原合酶是缺氧和复氧期间唯一发生变化的蛋白质，与常氧相比，在缺氧和复氧期间均增加了3倍。
text_en: In the brain, glycogen synthase is the only protein that changes during hypoxia and reoxygenation, increasing by 3-fold compared to normoxia during both hypoxia and reoxygenation.
outcome: 大脑糖原代谢蛋白表达

quote: The brain proteome did not show any specific grouping according to oxygen exposure, demonstrated by complete overlap between the groups along the component axes (Fig. 1).
statement: 脑蛋白质组没有显示出根据氧气暴露的特异性分组，表现为各组在成分轴上的完全重叠。
text_zh: 脑蛋白质组没有显示出根据氧气暴露的特异性分组，表现为各组在成分轴上的完全重叠。
text_en: The brain proteome did not show specific grouping according to oxygen exposure, manifested as complete overlap of the groups on the compositional axis.

quote: The brain and liver proteome did not show any specific grouping according to treatment, as demonstrated by the overlap between groups along the PC axes (Fig. 1).
statement: 脑和肝脏的蛋白质组未显示出根据处理（缺氧/复氧）的特异性分组，表现为沿主成分轴的组间重叠。
text_zh: 脑和肝脏的蛋白质组未显示出根据处理（缺氧/复氧）的特异性分组，表现为沿主成分轴的组间重叠。
text_en: The proteomes of the brain and liver did not show specific grouping according to treatment (hypoxia/reoxygenation), as indicated by inter-group overlap along the principal component axes.

quote: The normoxic group in heart tissue appeared to be most different from the proteome profiles of anoxia and reoxygenation (Fig. 1).
statement: 心脏组织中的常氧组在蛋白质组谱上似乎与缺氧组和复氧组差异最大。
text_zh: 心脏组织中的常氧组在蛋白质组谱上似乎与缺氧组和复氧组差异最大。
text_en: The normoxic group in heart tissue appears to have the greatest difference in proteomic profile compared to the hypoxic and reoxygenation groups.

quote: The brain was least affected by anoxia and reoxygenation with only 66 proteins significantly changed (Fig. 2).
statement: 大脑受缺氧和复氧的影响最小，仅有66种蛋白质发生显著变化。
text_zh: 大脑受缺氧和复氧的影响最小，仅有66种蛋白质发生显著变化。
text_en: The brain was least affected by hypoxia and reoxygenation, with only 66 proteins showing significant changes.

quote: The highest number of significantly changed proteins was found in the heart, where 243 proteins changed significantly between the experimental groups (Fig. 2).
statement: 在实验组之间发现显著变化的蛋白质数量最多的是心脏，共有243种蛋白质发生显著变化。
text_zh: 在实验组之间发现显著变化的蛋白质数量最多的是心脏，共有243种蛋白质发生显著变化。
text_en: The heart had the highest number of proteins with significant changes among the experimental groups, with a total of 243 proteins showing significant changes.

quote: Combined with decreased protein levels of VDAC1 (Table 2), part of the mitochondrial permeability transition pore assembly (MPTP) (Karch & Molkentin, 2014), we speculate that a decrease in abundance of these proteins could be implicated in regulation of the MPTP.
statement: 结合VDAC1蛋白水平的降低（MPTP组装的一部分），我们推测这些蛋白质丰度的降低可能与MPTP的调节有关。
text_zh: 结合VDAC1蛋白水平的降低（MPTP组装的一部分），我们推测这些蛋白质丰度的降低可能与MPTP的调节有关。
text_en: Combined with the decrease in VDAC1 protein levels (part of MPTP assembly), we speculate that these reductions in protein abundance may be related to the regulation of MPTP.
outcome: 线粒体通透性转换孔调节

quote: In addition, complement decay accelerating factor, which inhibits C3 activation (Sun et al., 1999), decreased in anoxia (0.14 fold change) and in reoxygenation (0.37 fold change) compared to normoxia (Table 4).
statement: 此外，抑制C3激活的补体衰变加速因子在缺氧（0.14倍变化）和复氧（0.37倍变化）期间比常氧期间减少。
text_zh: 此外，抑制C3激活的补体衰变加速因子在缺氧（0.14倍变化）和复氧（0.37倍变化）期间比常氧期间减少。
text_en: In addition, the complement decay-accelerating factor that inhibits C3 activation decreased during hypoxia (0.14-fold change) and reoxygenation (0.37-fold change) compared to normoxia.

quote: Fish were fed twice daily based on apparent satiety (6:30 and 16:30).
statement: 鱼每天根据表观饱食度喂食两次（6:30和16:30）。
text_zh: 鱼每天根据表观饱食度喂食两次（6:30和16:30）。
text_en: Fish were fed twice daily based on apparent satiation (6:30 and 16:30).

quote: Fish mortality was recorded daily.
statement: 每日记录鱼的死亡率。
text_zh: 每日记录鱼的死亡率。
text_en: Fish mortality was recorded daily.

quote: DO was maintained at ≥6.5 mg/L, and total ammonia nitrogen was below 0.1 mg/L throughout the feeding process.
statement: 在整个饲养过程中，溶解氧维持在≥6.5 mg/L，总氨氮低于0.1 mg/L。
text_zh: 在整个饲养过程中，溶解氧维持在≥6.5 mg/L，总氨氮低于0.1 mg/L。
text_en: Throughout the rearing process, dissolved oxygen was maintained at ≥6.5 mg/L and total ammonia nitrogen was below 0.1 mg/L.
